**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall [then] make the mishkon (Tabernacle) out of ten drapes, [consisting of] fine twined linen, greenish blue, dark red and crimson [wool]. Figures of cherubim, the work of a craftsman, shall be woven into them.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with keruvim of artistic work shalt thou make them.

Each drape shall be twenty eight amohs long, and each drape shall be four amohs wide. All the drapes shall have the same measure.

The length of one curtain, twenty-eight cubits; and the width, four cubits for one curtain — one measure for all the curtains.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:8)

Each plank shall be ten amohs long, and one and one half amohs shall be the width of each plank.

וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For the second wall of the mishkon, to the northern side, [also make] twenty planks.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And for the second side of the tabernacle, the northern side, twenty beams.


###### Exodus 26:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:21)


וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
[Make] their forty silver sockets, two sockets under each plank, two sockets under each plank.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And their forty silver sockets, two sockets under one beam and two sockets under the next beam.


###### Exodus 26:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:22)


וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For the west end of the mishkon make six planks.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And for the side of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And for the ends [i.e., the back] of the tabernacle on the west, you shall make six beams, [accounting for nine cubits of width.]


###### Exodus 26:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:23)


וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make two planks for the corners of the mishkon at the rear side.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the west side.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And two beams shall you make for the corners of the tabernacle at the ends, [(so that the interior width is ten cubits)].


###### Exodus 26:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:24)


וְיִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִם֮ מִלְּמַ֒טָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַמִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They must be coupled together on the bottom, and they must also be coupled together evenly on the top with one [square] ring. So must it be done with the two [planks], which are at the two corners.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they (the beams) shall be fitted against each other at the bottom, and together shall they be fitted at its top into one ring. [Two adjacent beams were fixed together by a ring placed in grooves along their breadth.] So shall it be for the two of them [for the two beams at the end, the beam at the northern end and the western beam, and so,] for the two corners shall they be.


###### Exodus 26:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:25)


וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Thus there will be eight planks, and their silver sockets, totaling sixteen sockets, two sockets under each plank, two sockets under each plank.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [on the western side] there shall be eight beams and their silver sockets, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one beam and two sockets under the next beam.


###### Exodus 26:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:26)


וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make bars out of acacia wood, five for the planks of one wall,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the beams of one side of the tabernacle [These "five" are three, the upper and lower bars, respectively, consisting of two equal (fifteen cubit segments) running along the side wall, and one bar running the entire length through a hole bored in each beam.]


###### Exodus 26:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:27)


וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְקַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
and five bars for the planks of the second wall of the mishkon. [There shall also be] five bars for the planks of the western [back] wall of the mishkon.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the third side of the tabernacle, for the side westward.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And five bars for the beams of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the beams of the side of the tabernacle at the western ends.


###### Exodus 26:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:28)


וְהַבְּרִ֥יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֖ן בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן־הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־הַקָּצֶֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The middle [center] bar shall go through the planks, reinforcing the planks from one end to the other.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the middle bar in the midst of the beams shall extend from end to end.


###### Exodus 26:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:29)


וְֽאֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת־הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall overlay the planks with gold, and make their rings out of gold, to hold the bars. You shall [also] overlay the bars with gold.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the beams shall you cover with gold, and their rings shall you make of gold [to serve as] housings for the bars, and you shall cover the bars with gold [i.e., They will be "covered" with gold when they are inserted into the golden rings flanked by the golden half-reeds on either side.]


###### Exodus 26:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:30)


וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּמִ֨שְׁפָּט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הׇרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּהָֽר׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall erect the mishkon according to its rules. As shown to you on the mountain.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to its fashion which was shown thee in the mountain.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall set up the tabernacle after the manner which will have been shown to you [by the L-rd] in the mountain.


###### Exodus 26:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:31)


וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make a paroches [partition] out of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson wool, and twined, fine linen. It shall be the work of a craftsman, with figures of cherubim [woven into it].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen with keruvim shall it be made of artistic work:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make a *parocheth* (partition) of blue wool and purple wool and scarlet wool and twisted linen. Artistic work shall he make it, cherubs. [See Rashi on verse 1].


###### Exodus 26:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:32)


וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ עַל־אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־כָֽסֶף׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Place it [the paroches] upon four acacia-wood pillars, that are overlaid with gold. Their hooks shall [also] be of gold. These pillars are to be set into four silver sockets.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon four sockets of silver.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall place it on four pillars of acacia wood covered with gold, their hooks of gold [(Hooks bent upwards were set in the pillars on which to place the pole on which the top of the *parocheth* was wrapped)] (the pillars standing) upon four sockets of silver.


###### Exodus 26:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:33)


וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֘כֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַקְּרָסִים֒ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְהִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַפָּרֹ֙כֶת֙ לָכֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּבֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Place the paroches under the clasps [which kept the drapes together]. Bring into the space within [behind] the paroches, the Ark of the Testimony, and the paroches will divide for you between the Holy and the Holy of Holies.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt hang up the veil under the clasps, that thou mayst bring in there within the veil the ark of the Testimony: and the veil shall be for you as a division between the holy place and the most holy.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall put the *parocheth* under the hooks, and you shall bring there, inside the *parocheth*, the ark of testimony; and the *parocheth* shall separate for you between the holy and the holy of holies.


###### Exodus 26:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:34)


וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Place the cover upon the Ark of the Testimony in the Holy of Holies.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt put the covering upon the ark of the Testimony in the most holy place.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall put the *kaporeth* (the lid) upon the ark of testimony in the holy of holies.


###### Exodus 26:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:35)


וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהַ֨שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Put the table outside the paroches, and the menorah opposite the table, toward the southern side of the mishkon. The table should be placed on the northern side.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt set the table outside the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall place the table outside the *parocheth*, and the menorah opposite the table on the southern side of the tabernacle; and the table shall you place on the northern side.


###### Exodus 26:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:36)


וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent. [Make it out of] greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson wool, and twined, fine linen. It shall be the work of an embroiderer.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make a screen [a curtain] for the entrance of the tent, of blue wool, purple wool, scarlet wool, and twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer [needlework, the figures on one side being the same as those on the other.]


###### Exodus 26:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/26:37)


וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לַמָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make five pillars of acacia wood for the screen. Overlay them with gold and their hooks are to be gold. Cast five copper sockets for them [the pillars].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make for the screen five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia wood, and you shall cover them with gold, and their hooks (shall be) of gold; and you shall cast for them five copper sockets.



## Chapter 27

###### Exodus 27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:1)


וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְחָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make the altar out of acacia wood. It shall be five amohs long, and five amohs wide. The altar shall be square, and its height shall be three amohs.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height of it shall be three cubits.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square and three cubits high.


###### Exodus 27:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:2)


וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make its raised projections on its four corners. Its raised projections shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it [the altar] with copper.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make the horns of it upon its four corners: its horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make its horns on its four corners. From it [the altar itself] shall its horns be, [and not first made and then attached to it.] and you shall cover it with copper [to atone for brazenness (see Isaiah 48:4)].


###### Exodus 27:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:3)


וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו֙ לְדַשְּׁנ֔וֹ וְיָעָיו֙ וּמִזְרְקֹתָ֔יו וּמִזְלְגֹתָ֖יו וּמַחְתֹּתָ֑יו לְכׇל־כֵּלָ֖יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make its pots to remove its ashes, [also] its scoops, its basins, its flesh hooks, and its fire pans. Make all of its vessels out of copper.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its firepans: all its vessels thou shalt make of brass.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make its pots (into which) to empty its ashes, and its shovels [with which to remove its ashes], and its sprinkling basins [in which to receive the blood of the sacrifices], and its spits, and its fire-pans [for taking coals from the outer altar to the inner altar for the burning of the incense]. All of its implements shall you make of copper.


###### Exodus 27:4

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make for it a grate of copper netting. On the grate you shall make four copper rings on its four corners.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make for it a copper lattice, netting work. And you shall make on the netting four copper rings at its four edges.

All the pillars around the enclosure shall have silver bands, and silver hooks, and copper sockets.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:19)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
All the vessels of the mishkon in all its service, all of its stakes and all the stakes of the enclosure, shall be made of copper.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Exodus 27:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:20)


וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה**׀** אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃

You shall command the B’nei Yisrael and have them bring you clear olive oil, [made from olives that were] crushed for lighting, to keep the lamp burning constantly.

And thou shalt command the children of Yisra᾽el, that they bring thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Exodus 27:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/27:21)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
In the Tent of Meeting, outside the paroches, which is before the Testimony, Aharon and his sons shall arrange it [for the lamp to burn] from evening to morning before Adonoy. This is an everlasting statute for their generations of the B’nei Yisrael.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 28

###### Exodus 28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:1)


וְאַתָּ֡ה הַקְרֵ֣ב אֵלֶ֩יךָ֩ אֶת־אַהֲרֹ֨ן אָחִ֜יךָ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֗וֹ מִתּ֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְכַהֲנוֹ־לִ֑י אַהֲרֹ֕ן נָדָ֧ב וַאֲבִיה֛וּא אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְאִיתָמָ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And [now separate] and take unto you your brother, Aharon, and his sons with him, from among the B’nei Yisrael, to serve Me [as kohanim]: Aharon, Nadav, Avihu, Elazar, and Isamar, the sons of Aharon.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And take thou to thee Aharon thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Yisra᾽el that he may minister to me in the priest’s office, Aharon, Nadav, and Avihu, El῾azar, and Itamar, the sons of Aharon.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you, draw near to yourself [after completing the work of the tabernacle] Aaron your brother and his sons with him from the midst of the children of Israel to be a priest unto Me — Aaron, Nadav and Avihu, Elazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron.


###### Exodus 28:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:2)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make sacred garments for your brother, Aharon, for honor and splendor.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Exodus 28:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:3)


וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־כׇּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּאתִ֖יו ר֣וּחַ חׇכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֞וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן לְקַדְּשׁ֖וֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ־לִֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, and have them make Aharon’s garments, to sanctify him to serve Me [as kohein].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt speak to all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aharon’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall speak to all the wise of heart whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make the vestments of Aaron to sanctify him, to make him a Cohein [a ministering priest] unto Me.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

And they shall make garments of kodesh [i.e., from the contribution that has been consecrated (mekudesheth) for My name] for Aaron your brother and for his sons to make him a Cohein unto Me.

וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ אֶת־אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔יךָ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֨ אֹתָ֜ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֧ אֶת־יָדָ֛ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם וְכִהֲנ֥וּ לִֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Clothe your brother, Aharon, with [these garments], and also [clothe] his sons along with him. [Then] anoint them, and install them, and consecrate them to serve Me [as kohanim].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt put them upon Aharon thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall dress with them [the eight garments] Aaron your brother, and [with the four garments] his sons with him, and you shall anoint them [Aaron and his sons (with the anointing oil)], and you shall fill their hands [i.e., you shall invest them], and you shall sanctify them, and they shall minister unto Me.


###### Exodus 28:42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:42)


וַעֲשֵׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִכְנְסֵי־בָ֔ד לְכַסּ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֣ר עֶרְוָ֑ה מִמׇּתְנַ֥יִם וְעַד־יְרֵכַ֖יִם יִהְיֽוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make for them linen pants to cover their nakedness, reaching from their waists to their thighs.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even to the thighs they shall reach:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make for them [for Aaron and for his sons] pants (michnasayim) of linen to cover the flesh of nakedness. From the hips to the thighs shall they be.


###### Exodus 28:43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/28:43)


וְהָיוּ֩ עַל־אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְעַל־בָּנָ֜יו בְּבֹאָ֣ם**׀** אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְלֹא־יִשְׂא֥וּ עָוֺ֖ן וָמֵ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ל֖וֹ וּלְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
These [garments] must be worn by Aharon and his sons whenever they come into Tent of Meeting, or approach the altar to serve in the Holy [sanctuary], in order that they not bear iniquity and die. This is an everlasting statute for him and his descendants after him.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and they shall be upon Aharon, and upon his sons, when they come in the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever to him and his seed after him.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they [their respective garments] shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they come to the tent of meeting [to the heichal (Temple); likewise, to the mishkan (tabernacle)] or when they draw near to the altar to serve in holiness, that they not bear a sin and die [ — whence it is derived that a Cohein who ministers lacking one of the priestly garments incurs death (at the hands of Heaven)], an eternal statute [categorical (for validity of the service) immediately and for future generations], for him and for his seed after him.

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This is what you must do for them to consecrate them to serve Me [as kohanim]. Take one young bull and two unblemished rams,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And this is the thing that you shall do to them to sanctify them to minister unto Me: Take one young bullock [to atone for the sin of the golden calf (that "calf" being a bullock)] and two unblemished rams.

[also] unleavened bread, unleavened loaves mixed with [olive] oil. and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You must make them with fine wheat flour.

and unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened mingled with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [(ten of each of the following kinds:)] matzah bread [(later referred to as "challah of oil bread" (23) because he puts as much oil into it as into the loaves and wafers combined)], and matzah challoth mixed with oil [when they are still flour], and matzah wafers anointed with oil. [After they are baked, he anoints them in the shape of the Greek letter chi, similar to our nun.] Of fine wheat flour shall you make them.

###### Exodus 29:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:18)


וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאַ֙יִל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיח֔וֹחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Burn the entire ram on the altar, it is a burnt-offering to Adonoy, a pleasing fragrance, a fire-offering to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering to the Lord: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall smoke the entire ram upon the altar. It is a burnt-offering to the L-rd, a fragrance that is pleasing [in that His will was done], a fire-offering [i.e., the smoking of the limbs on the fire] to the L-rd.


###### Exodus 29:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:19)


וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Take the second ram and have Aharon and his sons support their hands on the head of the ram.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aharon and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the ram.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands on the head of the ram.


###### Exodus 29:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:20)


וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמוֹ֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל־תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל־תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְזָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Slaughter the ram, and take of its blood, and place it on the tip of Aharon’s right ear, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hands, and on the big toe of their right feet. Sprinkle the [remaining] blood all around the altar.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of its blood, and put it upon the tip of Aharon’s right ear, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall slaughter the ram, and you shall take of its blood and you shall place it on the t'nuch of the ear [the cartilage of the middle section inside the ear] of Aaron, and on the t'nuch of the ear of his sons — the right (ear) — and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. And you shall toss the blood on the altar roundabout.


###### Exodus 29:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:21)


וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן־הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֘חַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒ וְהִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְעַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וְקָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּבְגָדָ֔יו וּבָנָ֛יו וּבִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil and sprinkle it upon Aharon and his garments, and upon his sons and their garments as well. Thus he and his garments will be consecrated, along with his sons and his son’s garments.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aharon, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall take some of the blood which is on the altar and some of the anointment oil, and you shall sprinkle it upon Aaron and upon his garments and upon his sons and upon the garments of his sons with him. And he and his garments and his sons and the garments of his sons with him shall be sanctified.


###### Exodus 29:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:22)


וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן־הָ֠אַ֠יִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב**׀** הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת**׀** שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Take from the ram the [intestinal] fat, the broad tail, the fat that covers the inner organs, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder, for it is a ram of a completion-offering.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall take from the ram the fat [of the small intestines, or (according to another opinion) the stomach], and the fat-tail, [from the kidneys and below], and the fat that covers the innards, and the lobe with [some of] the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them and the right thigh [(This is the only instance of the smoking of the right thigh with the eimurim [the consecrated parts])]; for it is the ram of miluim (completeness) [a peace-offering (shelamim), complete in that all share in it: the altar, the officiator (in this instance, Moses, who receives the breast), and the owners (in this instance, Aaron and his sons, who eat the rest of it)].


###### Exodus 29:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:23)


וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִסַּל֙ הַמַּצּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
[Take also] one bread-cake, and one loaf of oiled bread, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the Lord:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And one loaf of bread [from the (matzah) challoth (see 2)], and one challah of oil bread, and one wafer from the basket of matzoth which is before the L-rd. [(This is the only instance of a bread offering accompanying an animal offering, being burned on the altar)].


###### Exodus 29:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:24)


וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Place all [these things] upon the [open] hands of Aharon, and upon the [open] hands of his sons, and you shall wave them for wave-offering before Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and thou shalt put all in the hands of Aharon, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall place all of it on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and you shall wave them a waving before the L-rd. [The Cohein (in this instance, Moses) places his hand under that of the owner (in this instance, Aaron and his sons, who held the parts), and he moves them back and forth (to the Owner of the four winds of the world). Waving staves off punishment and ill winds. In "lifting" (27), he lifts and lowers them (to the Owner of heaven and earth). Lifting staves off harmful dews.]


###### Exodus 29:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:25)


וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיח֙וֹחַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Then take [these things] from their hands and burn them on the altar after the burnt-offering as a pleasing fragrance before Adonoy. It is a fire-offering to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the Lord: it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall take them from their hand and you shall smoke them on the altar after the [first ram which you brought as a] burnt-offering, a pleasing fragrance before the L-rd. It is a fire-offering to the L-rd [i.e., in His name].


###### Exodus 29:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:26)


וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמָנָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Take the breast from Aharon’s installation ram and wave it as wave-offering to Adonoy. Then it shall be your [Moshe’s] portion.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aharon’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord: and it shall be thy part.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall take the breast of the ram of miluim which is Aaron's, and you shall wave it, a waving before the L-rd, and it shall be a portion for you.


###### Exodus 29:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:27)


וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת**׀** חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵאֵיל֙ הַמִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבָנָֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Sanctify the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the terumah-offering which were [the] waved and uplifted [parts] of the ram of the completion-offering [which was used to install] Aharon and his sons.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up of the ram of the consecration, of that which is for Aharon, and of that which is for his sons:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall consecrate [for waving and lifting in peace-offerings of future generations] the breast of the waving and the thigh of the lifting, which was waved and which was lifted, from the ram of the miluim which is Aaron's and his sons'.


###### Exodus 29:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:28)


וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחׇק־עוֹלָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖ם לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
It [the breast and shoulder] shall be for Aharon and his sons by statute for ever. [This portion is taken] from the B’nei Yisrael for it is a terumah-offering. It shall be a terumah-offering from the B’nei Yisrael taken from their peace-offerings. It is their terumah-offering to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and it shall be Aharon’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Yisra᾽el: for it is a heave offering: and it shall be a heave offering from the children of Yisra᾽el of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, their heave offering to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[But you shall not consecrate it for burning in future generations, for] it shall be for Aaron and his sons as an everlasting share from the children of Israel [to whom the peace-offerings belong]. For it [breast and thigh] is a devotion. And it shall be set aside by the children of Israel from the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, their devotion to the L-rd.


###### Exodus 29:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:29)


וּבִגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן יִהְי֥וּ לְבָנָ֖יו אַחֲרָ֑יו לְמׇשְׁחָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם וּלְמַלֵּא־בָ֖ם אֶת־יָדָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon’s sacred garments shall be his son’s after him, to be uplifted through them and to be installed through them.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the holy garments of Aharon shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the consecrated garments which are Aaron's shall be to his sons [of the high-priesthood] after him, to be exalted through them and to be invested [in the high-priesthood] through them.


###### Exodus 29:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:30)


שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖יו מִבָּנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֥ת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Seven [consecutive] days shall they be worn by he who serves in his place—one of his sons—who will come into the Tent of Meeting to serve in the Holy [Sanctuary].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And that son that is priest in his place shall put them on seven days, when he enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Seven [consecutive] days shall he don them, he who officiates in his stead, of his sons, who comes to the tent of meeting [i.e., who is qualified to enter the Holy of Holies on Yom Kippur, viz. the high-priest], to minister in the holy place.


###### Exodus 29:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:31)


וְאֵ֛ת אֵ֥יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֖ים תִּקָּ֑ח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֥ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בְּמָקֹ֥ם קָדֹֽשׁ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Take the [remainder of the] ram of the completion-offering and cook its flesh in a sacred place.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and boil its flesh in the holy place.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the miluim ram shall you take and you shall cook its flesh in a holy place [i.e., in the court of the tent of meeting, these peace-offerings being holy of holies].


###### Exodus 29:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:32)


וְאָכַ֨ל אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר הָאַ֔יִל וְאֶת־הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon and his sons shall eat the ram’s meat, along with the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket at the entrance [i.e., in the court] of the tent of meeting.


###### Exodus 29:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:33)


וְאָכְל֤וּ אֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֻּפַּ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם לְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־יָדָ֖ם לְקַדֵּ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑ם וְזָ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכַ֖ל כִּי־קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֵֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They are to eat those things through which atonement was achieved, to install them and [thereby] to sanctify them. A stranger [a non-kohein] may not eat thereof for they are sacred.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they shall eat those things with which atonement was made to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat of them, because they are holy.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they [Aaron and his sons, the owners,] shall eat them, so that there be atoned through them [any impurity they (Aaron and his sons) possess], to invest them [through the ram and the bread] and to consecrate them [in the priesthood]. And a stranger (i.e., a non-Cohein) may not eat, for they are holy [i.e., holy of holies (whence is derived the exhortation against a non-Cohein eating holy of holies)].


###### Exodus 29:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:34)


וְֽאִם־יִוָּתֵ֞ר מִבְּשַׂ֧ר הַמִּלֻּאִ֛ים וּמִן־הַלֶּ֖חֶם עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֤ אֶת־הַנּוֹתָר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל כִּי־קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If any meat of the installation-offering is left over or if any of the bread [is left over] until morning, you must burn the leftovers in fire. It must not be eaten for it is sacred.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if aught of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain to the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if anything be left over from the flesh of the miluim or from the bread until morning, you shall burn what is left over in fire. It shall not be eaten, for it is consecrated.


###### Exodus 29:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:35)


וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לְאַהֲרֹ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ כָּ֔כָה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּ֖יתִי אֹתָ֑כָה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תְּמַלֵּ֥א יָדָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
So shall you do for Aharon and his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. Seven days shall you install them.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thus shalt thou do to Aharon, and to his sons, according to all which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall do thus to Aaron and to his sons, according to everything I have commanded you [(The repetition renders the commandment categorical, so that if even one detail is omitted they are not invested.)] Seven days [i.e., on each of the seven days] shall you invest them [as indicated].


###### Exodus 29:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:36)


וּפַ֨ר חַטָּ֜את תַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה לַיּוֹם֙ עַל־הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּמָֽשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Offer a bull for a sin-offering each day for atonement; and by sprinkling [its blood] on the altar you will purify it [the altar.] You shall then anoint it to sanctify it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a bullock sin-offering shall you make each day for the cleansings [of the altar of any impurity], and you shall purify the altar [by application of blood with the finger] when you cleanse it. And you shall anoint it [with the anointing oil] to consecrate it.


###### Exodus 29:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:37)


שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹת֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֔ים כׇּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בַּמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and sanctify it and thus the altar will be Holy of Holies. Anything that touches the altar becomes sacred.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatever touches the altar shall be holy.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Seven days shall you cleanse the altar and you shall consecrate it. And the altar shall be holy of holies [in that] whatever touches the altar [(even an unfit offering)] shall be consecrated.


###### Exodus 29:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:38)


וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם תָּמִֽיד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And this is what you shall offer upon the altar: two yearling lambs each day, continually.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now this is what thou shalt offer on the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And this is what you shall offer upon the altar [("this": something like the burnt-offering which follows, i.e., an animal which was fit when it entered the Temple court — even if it became unfit thereafter. Such animals (but not those which were unfit before they entered), once they ascend the altar are not taken down)]: sheep in their first year, two each day, always.


###### Exodus 29:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:39)


אֶת־הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Offer one lamb in the morning and offer the second lamb in the afternoon.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer towards evening.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The one sheep shall you offer in the morning and the second sheep shall you offer in the afternoon.


###### Exodus 29:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:40)


וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין וְנֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And a tenth [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of pressed olive oil, and a libation of a fourth of a hin of wine for the first lamb.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And with the one lamb thou shalt bring a tenth measure of flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a tenth of [an ephah of] fine flour mixed with oil of crushing [i.e., extracted by crushing olives in a mortar (although it is also valid if the olives are ground in a mill. See 27:20)], a quarter of a hin; and a libation, a quarter of a hin of wine, for the one sheep.


###### Exodus 29:41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:41)


וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֔הּ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Offer the second lamb in the afternoon. As the meal-offering of the morning together with its libation, shall you offer it, for a pleasing fragrance, a fire-offering to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the other lamb thou shalt offer towards evening, and shalt do to it according the meal offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering of it, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the second sheep shall you offer in the afternoon. As the meal-offering of the morning and as its libation shall you offer it, a pleasing fragrance [(this, referring to the libation meal-offering, which is entirely burnt)], a fire-offering to the L-rd.


###### Exodus 29:42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:42)


עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִוָּעֵ֤ד לָכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This shall be a continual burnt-offering for your generations. [It shall be offered] at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, before Adonoy, where I will meet with you, to speak to you there.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the Lord: where I will meet you, to speak there to thee.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A continual [daily] burnt-offering for your generations, at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the L-rd, where I shall appoint a time for you to speak to you [i.e., When I set a time to speak with you, I shall set it for that place.]


###### Exodus 29:43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:43)


וְנֹעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
It is there that I will meet with the B’nei Yisrael, and it will be sanctified with My Glory.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And there I will meet with the children of Yisra᾽el, and it shall be sanctified by my glory.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I shall be appointed there for the children of Israel [to speak to them], and it [the mishkan] will be sanctified through My glory, [My shechinah resting therein.]


###### Exodus 29:44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:44)


וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֧ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֛יו אֲקַדֵּ֖שׁ לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and Aharon and his sons I will sanctify to serve Me as kohanim.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aharon and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I shall consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar; and Aaron and his sons shall I consecrate to minister unto Me.


###### Exodus 29:45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:45)


וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
I will dwell among the B’nei Yisrael, and I will be their God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I will dwell among the children of Yisra᾽el, and will be their God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I shall dwell in the midst of the children of Israel, and I shall be a G-d to them.


###### Exodus 29:46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/29:46)


וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְשׇׁכְנִ֣י בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They will know that I, Adonoy, am their God who brought them out of the land of Egypt to dwell among them. I am Adonoy, their God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, that brought them out of the land of Miżrayim, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they shall know that I am the L-rd their G-d who took them out of the land of Egypt so that I should dwell in their midst; I am the L-rd their G-d.



## Chapter 30

###### Exodus 30:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:1)


וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make an altar to burn incense. Make it out of Acacia wood.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make an altar for the burning of incense: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make an altar for the smoking of the spices; of acacia wood shall you make it.


###### Exodus 30:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:2)


אַמָּ֨ה אׇרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רׇחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
It shall be one amoh long and one amoh wide, it shall be a square, and two amohs high. Its horn-like elevations shall be of one piece with it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A cubit shall be the length of it, and a cubit its breadth; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be its height: the horns thereof shall be of the same.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A cubit its length and a cubit its width — square shall it be; and two cubits its height. From it shall its horns be (made).


###### Exodus 30:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:3)


וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall overlay it with pure gold, on its top, its walls all around, and its horn-like elevations, and make a gold crown-like rim all around it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, its top, and its sides round about, and its horns; and thou shalt make for it a rim of gold round about.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall cover it with pure gold, its roof and its walls roundabout and its horns; and you shall make for it a rim of gold roundabout [symbolizing "the crown of kehunah"].


###### Exodus 30:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:4)


וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ**׀** מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֵֽמָּה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make two gold rings for it under its crown-like rim, on two of its corners. Make them on its two opposite sides. They will house the poles with which it is carried.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And two golden rings shalt thou make for it under its rim, by its two corners upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the poles with which to bear it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And two golden rings shall you make for it. Beneath its rim at its two corners shall you make (them), on its two sides. And it [the ring-work] shall be for housings for the staves to carry it thereby.


###### Exodus 30:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:5)


וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Make the poles out of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt make the poles of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make the staves of acacia wood, and you shall cover them with gold.


###### Exodus 30:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:6)


וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Place it in front of the paroches that is by the Ark of the Testimony, in front of the covering that is on the Testimony where I will meet with you there.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the Testimony, before the covering that is over the Testimony, where I will meet with thee.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall place it before the parocheth which is by the ark of testimony, before the lid on the testimony [i.e., aligned directly opposite the ark, on the outside of the parocheth], where I shall be appointed for you.


###### Exodus 30:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:7)


וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיב֛וֹ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall burn upon it incense of spices. Every morning when he cleans the lamps, he shall burn it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon shall burn upon it sweet incense every morning: when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron shall smoke incense upon it every morning. When he cleans the lamps [the cups of the menorah (He would clean them of their ashes every morning)], he shall smoke it.


###### Exodus 30:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:8)


וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And when Aharon lights the lamps in the afternoon, he shall burn it. It is a continual incense -offering before Adonoy for your generations.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And when Aharon lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when Aaron kindles the lamps in the afternoon, he shall smoke it, [every day, half a portion in the morning, half in the afternoon], a continual incense before the L-rd for your generations.


###### Exodus 30:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:9)


לֹא־תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Do not bring upon it strange [unauthorized] incense; neither burnt-offerings nor meal-offerings. You shall not pour a libation-offering upon it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meal offering; neither shall you pour drink offering upon it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not bring up upon it strange [i.e., donated] incense, nor burnt-offering [any offering of animal or fowl], nor meal-offering [any offering of bread]; nor may you pour a libation upon it.


###### Exodus 30:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/30:10)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall make atonement on its horn-like elevations once each year. With the blood of the sin-offering of atonement, he shall make atonement on it once each year for your generations. It is Holy of Holies to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon shall sprinkle upon the horns of it once in a year the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron will make atonement [by application of the blood] upon its horns once a year [on Yom Kippur] with the blood of the sin-offering of the atonements [the bullock and the goat of Yom Kippur, which atone for impurity of the sanctuary and its sacred objects]. Once a year shall he make atonement upon it for your generations; it is holy of holies to the L-rd [It is consecrated for these things alone and for no other service.]

“When you take the count of the B’nei Yisrael to determine their numbers, each man shall give an atonement pledge for his soul to Adonoy, when you count them. Thus there will be no plague among them when you count them.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When thou dost take the sum of the children of Yisra᾽el after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to the Lord, when thou dost number them; that there be no plague among them, when thou dost number them.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[And count the shekalim, for the evil eye prevails over what is counted and makes it vulnerable to pestilence (See II Samuel 24:1-10)].

[Let them give] half this shekel as an offering to the L-rd.

["There is no 'earlier' and 'later' in the Torah" (This section is out of chronological order.) The incident of the golden calf preceded the charge to build the mishkan. For on the seventeenth of Tammuz the tablets were broken, and on Yom Kippur the L-rd was reconciled with Israel. And the next day they began donating for the mishkan, which was erected on the first of Nissan.] ("when He finished (kechalotho) speaking with him") ["kechalotho" is written defective (without the vav). The Torah was given to Moses as a gift, as a bride (kallah) is given to a groom, for he could not (in the order of nature) have learned all of it in such a short time.] ("when He finished speaking with him") [Moses heard the halachah first from the L-rd, and then they "reviewed" it together.] ("tablets" — luchoth) ["luchoth" is written defective (without the vav), intimating (in the Hebrew) that the tablets were identical.]

Moshe returned to Adonoy and said, “I beseech You! This people have committed a great sin and have made a god of gold.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe returned to the Lord, and said, Oh, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made them gods of gold.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses returned to the L-rd and he said: I implore You — This people has committed a great sin, and they have made for themselves gods of gold [(If You had not lavished so much gold upon them, they would not have sinned)].

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Now if You would bear [forgive] their sin, and if not, blot me out from Your book that You have written.”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin – ; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And now, if You will bear their sin, [good — do not erase me,] but if not, erase me, I pray You, from Your book that You have written [(Erase me from Your entire Torah, so that it not be said about me that I was not worthy enough to implore mercy for Israel.)]

Adonoy said to Moshe, “Those who have sinned against Me, I will blot out from My book.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

And now, go and lead the people whither I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel [ — but not I — ] shall go before you, and, [though I grant your petition not to destroy them outright,] on the day of My accounting [for other sins], I shall reckon their sin [of the golden calf] against them. ["No punishment comes upon Israel which does not contain some payment for the sin of the golden calf."]

into a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee on the way.

מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜ם חׇכְמַת־לֵ֗ב לַעֲשׂוֹת֮ כׇּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ׀וְחֹשֵׁב֒ וְרֹקֵ֞ם בַּתְּכֵ֣לֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּתוֹלַ֧עַת הַשָּׁנִ֛י וּבַשֵּׁ֖שׁ וְאֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כׇּל־מְלָאכָ֔ה וְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He filled them with wisdom of the heart, to execute all the tasks of the engraver, the craftsman, and the embroiderer of greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson wool, fine linen, and the [the tasks of] weaver, [also] that of laborers and planners.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Them has he filled with wisdom of heart, to do all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the craftsman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise artistic work.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He filled them with wisdom of heart to do every work of craftsman, artist, and embroiderer, in blue wool, purple wool, scarlet wool, and linen; and weaver, doing all work and making designs.

וְעָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְאׇהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְכֹ֣ל**׀** אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה חׇכְמָ֤ה וּתְבוּנָה֙ בָּהֵ֔מָּה לָדַ֣עַת לַעֲשֹׂ֔ת אֶֽת־כׇּל־מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And they shall execute—Betzalel and Oholiov—and every wise-hearted man whom Adonoy had endowed with wisdom and insight to know (how) to execute in all of the holy work—all that Adonoy had commanded.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then Beżal᾽el and Oholi᾽av, and every wisehearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, did according to all that the Lord had commanded.

###### Exodus 36:2

וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל־בְּצַלְאֵל֮ וְאֶל־אׇֽהֳלִיאָב֒ וְאֶל֙ כׇּל־אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה חׇכְמָ֖ה בְּלִבּ֑וֹ כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֔וֹ לְקׇרְבָ֥ה אֶל־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe called to Betzalel and to Oholiov, and to every wise-hearted man whom Adonoy had endowed with wisdom in his heart, everyone whose heart moved him to approach the task—to execute it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Exodus 36:3

וַיִּקְח֞וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַתְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִמְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑הּ וְ֠הֵ֠ם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥יו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And they took from before Moshe, all the terumah-offering which the B’nei Yisrael brought for the tasks of the holy work, to execute it. And they continued to bring gifts each and every morning.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and they received from Moshe all the offering, which the children of Yisra᾽el had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. And they brought yet to him free will offerings every morning.

וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כׇּל־הַ֣חֲכָמִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֕ים אֵ֖ת כׇּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אִֽישׁ־אִ֥ישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 37

###### Exodus 37:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/37:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/37:1)


וַיַּ֧עַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל אֶת־הָאָרֹ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אׇרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רׇחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Betzalel made the ark of acacia wood, two and one-half amohs long, one and one-half amohs wide, and one and one-half amohs high.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Beżal᾽el made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Betzalel made the ark [(its making being ascribed to him rather than to the other artisans because of his total dedication to the work)], of acacia wood: two and a half cubits, its length; one and a half cubits, its breadth; and one and a half cubits, its height.


###### Exodus 37:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/37:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/37:2)


וַיְצַפֵּ֛הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He covered it with pure gold from inside and out. He made for it a golden crown-like rim around (its top).


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a rim of gold to it round about.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he covered it with pure gold from inside and from outside. And he made for it a rim of gold roundabout.


###### Exodus 37:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/37:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/37:3)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meal offering; as the Lord commanded Moshe.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the burnt-offering altar he placed at the entrance of the mishkan of the tent of meeting. And he offered up upon it the burnt-offering [the continual burnt-offering] and the meal-offering [accompanying the libations of the continual burnt-offering (29:40)], as the L-rd had commanded Moses.


###### Exodus 40:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:30)


וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרׇחְצָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He set the laver between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water into it for washing.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he set the laver between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water there, for washing.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he put the kiyyor between the tent of meeting and the altar, and he put there water for washing.


###### Exodus 40:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:31)


וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe, Aharon and his sons washed their hands and feet from it,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe and Aharon and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed from it their hands and their feet, [all of them being equal for kehunah on the eighth day of the investiture of the Cohanim (which was the day of the erection of the mishkan)].


###### Exodus 40:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:32)


בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקׇרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
when they came to the Tent of Meeting and when they approached the altar they would wash, just as Adonoy commanded Moshe.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
when they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moshe.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When they came to the tent of meeting and when they approached the altar they would wash, as the L-rd had commanded Moses.


###### Exodus 40:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:33)


וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He set up the enclosure around the mishkon and the altar, and put up the screen at the enclosure’s entrance, and thus Moshe completed the work.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he erected the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the court gate. So Moshe finished the work.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he erected the court around the mishkan and the altar, and he placed the screen of the gate of the court. And Moses completed the work.


###### Exodus 40:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:34)


וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of Adonoy filled the mishkon.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then a cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the L-rd filled the mishkan.


###### Exodus 40:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:35)


וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud rested on it, and the glory of Adonoy filled the mishkon.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe was not able to enter the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud rested on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses could not come to the tent of meeting, for the cloud rested upon it and the glory of the L-rd filled the mishkan.


###### Exodus 40:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:36)


וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
When the cloud rose up from over the mishkon, the B’nei Yisrael would set out in all their travels.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Yisra᾽el went onward in all their journeys:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when the cloud rose from the mishkan, the children of Israel would travel on all of their journeys.


###### Exodus 40:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:37)


וְאִם־לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If the cloud did not rise, they would not set out until the day that it rose.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
but if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if the cloud did not rise, they did not journey until the day of its rising.


###### Exodus 40:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Exodus/r/40:38)


כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֤ה עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כׇל־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכׇל־מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For the cloud of Adonoy was upon the mishkon by day, and there was a fire in it by night, before the eyes of the entire Beis Yisrael, in all their travels.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Yisra᾽el, throughout all their journeys.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the cloud of the L-rd was on the mishkan by day, and a fire was in it at night before the eyes of all the house of Israel in all of their journeyings [i.e., in all the encampments of their journeyings].
