וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן הַ֠יּ֠וֹם הִקְרִ֨יבוּ אֶת־חַטָּאתָ֤ם וְאֶת־עֹֽלָתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַתִּקְרֶ֥אנָה אֹתִ֖י כָּאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָכַ֤לְתִּי חַטָּאת֙ הַיּ֔וֹם הַיִּיטַ֖ב בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon spoke [in reply] to Moshe, Behold, today they brought their sin-offerings and their burnt-offerings before Adonoy and then such [tragedy] befell me. If I had eaten the sin-offering today, would that have been good in the eyes of Adonoy?


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon said to Moshe, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; and such things have befallen me that if I had eaten the sin offering today, should it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron spoke ["with heart"] to Moses [(knowing that Moses' words were really meant for him and that his sons were maintaining a deferential silence)]: Now did they this day offer their sin-offering and their burnt-offering before the L-rd! [Moses had said to them: Is it possible that you sprinkled its blood being onenim! (the service of an onein being pasul) — to which Aaron replied: Is it they, ordinary priests, who offered the sacrifice? Is it not I who did so? (the high-priest sacrificing even when he is an onein)] Now if there had befallen me [even the death of other kin for whom I must become an onein (see Chapter 21)], such as these [my sons], and I had eaten the sin-offering this day [(an onein is permitted to eat at night)], would it be good in the eyes of the L-rd! [(If you have heard (from the L-rd) that this (such eating) is permitted with kodshim for a particular occasion (the investiture), this is no license for permitting it in "ongoing" kodshim (such as the Rosh Chodesh goat)].

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe heard, and it was good in his eyes.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And when Moshe heard that, he was content.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses heard, and it was good in his eyes. [He admitted (that he had heard this from the L-rd but had forgotten) instead of "covering up" (by saying that he had not heard)].

Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying: these are the living things that you may eat from among all the animals that are on the earth.

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
All that have a cloven hoof, and they [the hooves] are [completely] split and that [also] chews its cud among animals, you may eat it.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Whatever has parted hooves, and whose hooves are wholly cloven, and which chews its cud [lit., "which brings up its cud" (to chew again)] in the beast [(including an embryo found in the mother)] it shall you eat [(a positive commandment added to the negative (below) to make for "double" transgression in the instance of non-observance)]

However, these you may eat of all the flying insects that walk on four [legs], those which have knees extending above their legs so that it hops on the ground with them.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Yet these may you eat of every flying creeping thing that goes upon four, which have legs above their feet, to leap with upon the earth;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Only this may you eat of all creeping things that fly, which walk on four — that which has kera'aim [foot-like projections] above its feet [near its neck] with which to spring from the earth.

these of them you may eat; the locust after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind, and the ĥargol after its kind, and the ĥagav after its kind.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
These of them you may eat: the arbeh after its kind, and the salam after its kind, and the chargol after its kind, and the chagav after its kind.

And whatever any of them falls upon, when they are dead, shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it be, in which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until evening, then it shall be clean.

###### Leviticus 11:40

###### Leviticus 13:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:4)


וְאִם־בַּהֶ֩רֶת֩ לְבָנָ֨ה הִ֜וא בְּע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֗וֹ וְעָמֹק֙ אֵין־מַרְאֶ֣הָ מִן־הָע֔וֹר וּשְׂעָרָ֖הֿ לֹא־הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If it is a snow-white spot in the skin of the flesh and it does not appear deeper than the skin and the hair did not turn white, the *kohein* shall confine the plague for seven days.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and be not deeper in appearance than the skin, and its hair be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that has the plague seven days:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if it is a white bahereth in the skin of his flesh, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair had not turned white, then the Cohein shall quarantine the plague-spot for seven days, [not to be looked at until the end of the week].


###### Leviticus 13:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:5)


וְרָאָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵן֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמַ֣ד בְּעֵינָ֔יו לֹֽא־פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּע֑וֹר וְהִסְגִּיר֧וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall see him on the seventh day and behold! [if] the skin-eruption has maintained its hue; the skin-eruption did not spread in the skin. The *kohein* shall confine him for seven days, a second time,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall look on him on the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall see it on the seventh day; and if the plague-spot appears as it did before [in appearance and size], if the plague-spot did not spread in the skin, then the Cohein shall quarantine it for a second seven days, [but if it spread in the first week, he is a confirmed leper].


###### Leviticus 13:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:6)


וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֹת֜וֹ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֮ שֵׁנִית֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹא־פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּע֑וֹר וְטִהֲר֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִסְפַּ֣חַת הִ֔וא וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall see him on the seventh day for the second time and behold! [if] the skin-eruption became dimmer and the skin-eruption did not spread in the skin, the *kohein* shall declare him [to be] clean; it is [merely] a white discoloration. He shall wash his garments and he will be cleansed.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall look on him again on the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dimmer, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall see it on the seventh day again; and if the plague-spot is dim, and the plague-spot has not spread in the skin, then the Cohein shall declare him clean [(but if it remained the same or spread, he is unclean)]; it is a mispachath [a type of clean plague-spot], and he shall wash his clothes and be clean [(Since he required quarantine he is called "unclean" and requires immersion.)]


###### Leviticus 13:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:7)


וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֨ה תִפְשֶׂ֤ה הַמִּסְפַּ֙חַת֙ בָּע֔וֹר אַחֲרֵ֧י הֵרָאֹת֛וֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְטׇהֳרָת֑וֹ וְנִרְאָ֥ה שֵׁנִ֖ית אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If the white discoloration has spread in the skin after it was shown to the *kohein,* who pronounced that it was clean, it must be shown a second time to the *kohein.*


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after he has been seen by the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen by the priest again:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if the mispachath spreads in the skin after he has shown himself to the Cohein for his cleansing, then he shall show himself a second time to the Cohein.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:8)


וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשְׂתָ֥ה הַמִּסְפַּ֖חַת בָּע֑וֹר וְטִמְּא֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן צָרַ֥עַת הִֽוא׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall see and behold! [if] the white discoloration has spread in the skin, the *kohein* shall declare him unclean, it is *tzoraas.*


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is żara῾at.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall see: If the mispachath has spread in the skin, then the Cohein shall declare him unclean, [whereupon he is a confirmed leper, requiring birds, shaving, and the offering (see Chapter 14)]. It [this mispachath] is leprosy.


###### Leviticus 13:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:9)


נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאָדָ֑ם וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
When there is a skin-eruption of *tzoraas* on a person he shall be brought to the *kohein.*


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When the plague of żara῾at is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A plague-spot of leprosy, if it be in a man, then he shall be brought to the Cohein.


###### Leviticus 13:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:10)


וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־לְבָנָה֙ בָּע֔וֹר וְהִ֕יא הָפְכָ֖ה שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֑ן וּמִֽחְיַ֛ת בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י בַּשְׂאֵֽת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall see and behold! there is an intensely white spot on the skin and it has turned the hair white or there is healthy flesh in the spot of intense whiteness,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall see him: and, behold, if a white swelling be in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall see, and behold, a white se'eth in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and the healthiness of living flesh within the rising, [part of the whiteness within the se'eth having assumed the appearance of flesh, this, too, is a sign of uncleanliness — white hair (even) without healthy flesh, or healthy flesh (even) without white hair. (Note: Though "healthy flesh" is stated only in reference to se'eth, it is a sign of uncleanliness in all plague-spots.)]


###### Leviticus 13:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:11)


צָרַ֨עַת נוֹשֶׁ֤נֶת הִוא֙ בְּע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ וְטִמְּא֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן לֹ֣א יַסְגִּרֶ֔נּוּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
it is an old *tzoraas* in the skin of his body and the *kohein* shall declare him unclean he shall not confine him, since he is [obviously] unclean.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
it is an old żara῾at in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
It is old leprosy in the skin of his flesh [(There is an old wound, full of pus, beneath the healthy flesh, so that the healthy flesh is no reason to declare him clean]. And the Cohein shall declare him unclean; he shall not quarantine him, for he is unclean.

וְאִם־פָּר֨וֹחַ תִּפְרַ֤ח הַצָּרַ֙עַת֙ בָּע֔וֹר וְכִסְּתָ֣ה הַצָּרַ֗עַת אֵ֚ת כׇּל־ע֣וֹר הַנֶּ֔גַע מֵרֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַד־רַגְלָ֑יו לְכׇל־מַרְאֵ֖ה עֵינֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

And if the leprosy blossom in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of the plague-spot, from his head until his feet, to all the sight of the eyes of the Cohein [(to exclude a Cohein whose sight has dimmed)],

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the żara῾at have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that has the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall see, and behold, the leprosy has covered all of his flesh, then he shall declare the plague-spot clean; all of it has turned white — it is clean.


###### Leviticus 13:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/13:14)


וּבְי֨וֹם הֵרָא֥וֹת בּ֛וֹ בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃

On the day that healthy flesh appears on him, he will become unclean.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But when raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And on the day [(There is a "day" when plague-spots are inspected and a "day" when they are not inspected. A groom is given all seven days of his festivity — him, his garments, and his house (not to be inspected). Likewise, one is granted all the days of a festival.)] that there appear in it healthy flesh [(If a limb tip, which could not be rendered unclean by the appearance of healthy flesh (which normally does render a plague-spot unclean) because the entire limb, by virtue of its "slopes" could not be viewed at one time — If such a limb tip broadened and leveled, so that it could be viewed at one time, and healthy flesh appeared in it, then)] he shall be unclean.

###### Leviticus 13:59

זֹ֠את תּוֹרַ֨ת נֶֽגַע־צָרַ֜עַת בֶּ֥גֶד הַצֶּ֣מֶר**׀** א֣וֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּ֗ים א֤וֹ הַשְּׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ הָעֵ֔רֶב א֖וֹ כׇּל־כְּלִי־ע֑וֹר לְטַהֲר֖וֹ א֥וֹ לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This is the law of the eruption of *tzoraas* be it in a woolen garment, or a linen garment, or in the warp [lengthwise] thread, or in the woof [widthwise] thread, or in any leather-made object, that it be pronounced pure, or that it be pronounced impure.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This is the Tora of the plague of żara῾at in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or anything of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
This is the law of the plague-spot of leprosy, in a garment of wool or linen, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any article of skin, to declare it clean or to declare it unclean.

זֹ֤את תִּֽהְיֶה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת הַמְּצֹרָ֔ע בְּי֖וֹם טׇהֳרָת֑וֹ וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Leviticus 14:3

וְיָצָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נִרְפָּ֥א נֶֽגַע־הַצָּרַ֖עַת מִן־הַצָּרֽוּעַ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall go out beyond the encampment. The *kohein* shall see; and behold! the skin-eruption of *tzoraas* has healed from the person with *tzoraas*.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall go out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of żara῾at be healed in the one afflicted;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall go outside the camp [(outside the three camps, where the leper was sent in the days of his confirmed leprosy)], and the Cohein shall see, and, behold, if the plague-spot of leprosy is healed from the leper,


###### Leviticus 14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:4)


וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלָקַ֧ח לַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר שְׁתֵּֽי־צִפֳּרִ֥ים חַיּ֖וֹת טְהֹר֑וֹת וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall command to take for the person undergoing purification two live, pure [kosher] birds, cedar wood, crimson thread and hyssop.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then the Cohein shall command that there be taken for the one to be cleansed two clean, living [(excluding treifah)] birds. ([Leprosy, coming upon one because of slander, birds ("chirpers") are brought)], and cedar-wood [(leprosy coming upon one (also) because of pride)], and [a tongue of] wool (dyed) scarlet (sh'ni tola'ath), and hyssop. [What is his "remedy"? Let him "lower" himself, like a worm (tola'ath) and like hyssop.]


###### Leviticus 14:5

וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־הַצִּפּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־כְּלִי־חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall command to slaughter the one bird in an earthenware vessel, over running water.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall command and he shall slaughter one bird into an earthen vessel over living water [He places the water (a quarter of a log) in the vessel first so that the blood of the bird be discernible in it.]


###### Leviticus 14:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:6)


אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֤ר הַֽחַיָּה֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת־עֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וְאֶת־שְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֶת־הָאֵזֹ֑ב וְטָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת**׀** הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּ֗ה בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחֻטָ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽחַיִּֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
[As for] the living bird, he shall take it; and the cedar wood, the crimson thread and the hyssop and immerse them and the live bird in the blood of the slaughtered bird, over the running water.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
as for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The living bird, he shall take it [by itself] and the cedar-wood, and the scarlet wool, and the hyssop [(all three bound together)], and he shall dip them and the living bird [together] in the blood of the slaughtered bird over the living water.


###### Leviticus 14:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:7)


וְהִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן־הַצָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִ֣הֲר֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽחַיָּ֖ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall sprinkle on the person undergoing purification from the *tzoraas*, seven times and make him pure; and send the live bird into the open field.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the żara῾at seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall sprinkle upon the one to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and he shall cleanse him, and he shall send the living bird over the face of the field.


###### Leviticus 14:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:8)


וְכִבֶּס֩ הַמִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת־בְּגָדָ֜יו וְגִלַּ֣ח אֶת־כׇּל־שְׂעָר֗וֹ וְרָחַ֤ץ בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָשַׁ֛ב מִח֥וּץ לְאׇהֳל֖וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The person undergoing purification shall wash his garments, and shave off all of his hair, and bathe in water, and he will become purified. After [this], he may come into the encampment. He must remain, outside of his tent, for seven days.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water, and be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, but he shall remain outside his tent seven days.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the one to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and he shall shave all of his hair, and he shall bathe in water, and he shall be clean; and he shall come into the camp. And he shall sit outside his tent [(i.e., he shall abstain from marital relations)] for seven days.


###### Leviticus 14:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:9)


וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת־כׇּל־שְׂעָר֗וֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֤וֹ וְאֶת־זְקָנוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔יו וְאֶת־כׇּל־שְׂעָר֖וֹ יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְכִבֶּ֣ס אֶת־בְּגָדָ֗יו וְרָחַ֧ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
It shall be, that on the seventh day, he shall shave off all of his hair, [that of] his head, his beard and his eyebrows; he shall shave off all of his hair. He shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water and become purified.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall bathe his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it shall be on the seventh day that he shall shave all of his hair. His head, his beard, and the brows of his eyes — all of his [visible, "gathered"] hair shall he shave. And he shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.


###### Leviticus 14:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:10)


וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִקַּ֤ח שְׁנֵֽי־כְבָשִׂים֙ תְּמִימִ֔ם וְכַבְשָׂ֥ה אַחַ֛ת בַּת־שְׁנָתָ֖הּ תְּמִימָ֑ה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְלֹ֥ג אֶחָ֖ד שָֽׁמֶן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
On the eighth day, he shall take two unblemished lambs and one ewe in her first year, unblemished, and three tenths fine flour, for a meal-offering, mixed with oil and one *log* of oil.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth measures of fine flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one ewe-lamb of the first year, without blemish [for a sin-offering], and three tenth parts of (an ephah of) fine flour for a meal-offering, mixed with oil, [for the libations of these three lambs], and one log of oil [for the seven sprinklings and the applications on ear and thumbs].


###### Leviticus 14:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:11)


וְהֶעֱמִ֞יד הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽמְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְאֹתָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* doing the purification, shall place the man undergoing the purification and the [aforementioned] items, before Adonoy, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the priest that makes him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, at the door of the Tent of Meeting:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein that cleanses shall stand the man who is to be cleansed and those (things) before the L-rd [(at the gate of Nikanor, not in the azarah itself, for he lacks atonement)], at the door of the tent of meeting.


###### Leviticus 14:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:12)


וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֗ד וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛וֹ לְאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֥יף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall take one lamb and bring it as a guilt-offering, and (with) the *log* of oil and wave them as a wave-offering before Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer it for a guilt offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall take one of the he-lambs, and he shall bring it near [into the azarah] as a guilt-offering [to be waved (live)], and the log of oil, and he shall wave them [the guilt-offering and the log] before the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 14:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:13)


וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֶת־הַכֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠מְק֠וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת־הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֡י כַּ֠חַטָּ֠את הָאָשָׁ֥ם הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall slaughter the lamb in the place where he slaughters the sin-offering and the burnt-offering, in the sacred place; for, just as the sin-offering—is the guilt-offering; it belongs to the *kohein*, it is most holy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he shall slaughter the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the guilt offering: it is most holy:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall slaughter the lamb in the place where he slaughters the sin-offering and the burnt-offering [(on the side of the altar in the north)], in the holy place. For as the sin-offering [i.e., as all sin-offerings], the guilt-offering [i.e., this guilt-offering] is the Cohein's [i.e., it is subject to all of the Cohein's services for a sin-offering. But (unlike a sin-offering, its blood is not applied on the altar above (but it is dashed roundabout the altar below, for)] it is holy of holies. [see 7:2].


###### Leviticus 14:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:14)


וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵן֮ מִדַּ֣ם הָאָשָׁם֒ וְנָתַן֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַל־תְּנ֛וּךְ אֹ֥זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall take from the blood of the guilt-offering and the *kohein* shall put it on the middle ridge of the right ear of the person being purified, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall take from the blood of the guilt-offering, and the Cohein shall place it on the tnuch [the middle wall] of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.


###### Leviticus 14:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:15)


וְלָקַ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מִלֹּ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְיָצַ֛ק עַל־כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall take from the *log* of the oil and he shall pour it onto the koheins left palm.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall take from the log of oil, and he shall pour onto the Cohein's left palm.


###### Leviticus 14:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:16)


וְטָבַ֤ל הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־אֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־הַשֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall immerse his right finger in some of the oil that is on his left palm and he shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall dip his right finger from the oil on his left palm, and he shall sprinkle from the oil with his finger seven times before the L-rd [i.e., opposite the holy of holies].


###### Leviticus 14:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:17)


וּמִיֶּ֨תֶר הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כַּפּ֗וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַכֹּהֵן֙ עַל־תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַ֖ל דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
From the remaining oil that is on his palm, the *kohein* shall put on the middle ridge of the right ear of the person being purified, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot; on [over] the blood of the guilt-offering.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the guilt offering:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And from the rest of the oil which is on his palm, the Cohein shall place on the tnuch of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the guilt-offering.


###### Leviticus 14:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:18)


וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר בַּשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Whatever oil remains that is on the palm of the *kohein*, he shall put on the head of the person undergoing purification. The *kohein* will atone for him before Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the remnant of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And what is left over of the oil which is on the palm of the Cohein, he shall place on the head of the one who is to be cleansed, and the Cohein shall atone for him before the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 14:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:19)


וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַ֣חַטָּ֔את וְכִפֶּ֕ר עַל־הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִטֻּמְאָת֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־הָעֹלָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall do (offer) the sin-offering and atone for the person undergoing purification from his impurity and afterwards he shall slaughter the burnt-offering.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterwards he shall kill the burnt offering:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall offer up the sin-offering, and he shall atone for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanliness, and then he shall slaughter the burnt-offering.


###### Leviticus 14:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:20)


וְהֶעֱלָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽר׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall raise up the burnt-offering and the meal-offering onto the altar and the *kohein* will atone for him and he will be purified.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall offer up on the altar the burnt-offering and the [libation] meal-offering [which accompanies an animal sacrifice], and the Cohein shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.


###### Leviticus 14:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:21)


וְאִם־דַּ֣ל ה֗וּא וְאֵ֣ין יָדוֹ֮ מַשֶּׂ֒גֶת֒ וְ֠לָקַ֠ח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִתְנוּפָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְעִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן לְמִנְחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If he is poor and his means are not sufficient, he shall take one lamb as a guilt-offering, for a wave-offering to atone for him and one tenth fine flour mixed with oil, as a meal-offering and a *log* of oil.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if he be poor, and his means do not suffice; then he shall take one lamb for a guilt offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth measure of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if he is poor and his means do not suffice, then he shall take one he-lamb as a guilt-offering to be waved to make atonement for him, and one tenth-part of fine flour mixed with oil as a meal-offering, and a log of oil [for application on the thumbs].


###### Leviticus 14:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/14:22)


וּשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה אֶחָד֙ חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָֽה׃

And two turtledoves or two young pigeons such as his means suffice. One shall be for a sin-offering and one shall be for a burnt-offering.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as his means permit; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And two turtle-doves or two young pigeons, such as his means suffice for; and one shall be a sin-offering, and the other, a burnt-offering.

וְהֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜ם בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י לְטׇהֳרָת֖וֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃

When you will come into the land of Canaan that I will give to you for a possession, and I shall put the eruption of *tzoraas* in the house of the land of your possession.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

And he shall bathe his flesh in water and put them on. [He required five immersions and ablutions of hands and feet on that day for five changings (between inner and outer services)].

###### Leviticus 16:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:6)


וְהִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־פַּ֥ר הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall bring the sin-offering bullock which is his and atone on his own behalf and on behalf of his household.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon shall offer the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is his [(It must come from his own funds and not from community funds)], and he shall make atonement for himself and for his household [(He confesses over it his sins and those of his household)].


###### Leviticus 16:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:7)


וְלָקַ֖ח אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י הַשְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall take the two he-goats and stand them before Adonoy, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the Lord at the door of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall take the two he-goats and he shall stand them before the L-rd at the door of the tent of meeting.


###### Leviticus 16:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:8)


וְנָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׂעִירִ֖ם גֹּרָל֑וֹת גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְגוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַעֲזָאזֵֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall put lots on the two he-goats; one lot [marked] for Adonoy and one lot [marked] for Azazel.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the Lord, and the other lot for ῾Azazel.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron shall place lots upon the two he-goats, one lot for the L-rd, and the other lot for Azazel [a flinty crag (from which the goat was precipitated). He would place the goats on either side of him and from an urn draw lots, on one of which was written "for the L-rd"; on the other, "for Azazel")]


###### Leviticus 16:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:9)


וְהִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛יו הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֖הוּ חַטָּֽאת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall bring the goat upon which the lot [marked] for Adonoy came up and do (offer) it as a sin-offering.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon shall bring the goat upon which the Lord’s lot fell, and offer it for a sin offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron shall present the he-goat on which the lot came up for the L-rd, and he shall make it a sin-offering [(When he places the lot upon it he says: "For the L-rd, a sin-offering.")]


###### Leviticus 16:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:10)


וְהַשָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤יו הַגּוֹרָל֙ לַעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יׇֽעֳמַד־חַ֛י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו לְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֹת֛וֹ לַעֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The goat upon which came up the lot [marked] for Azazel shall be placed, alive, before Adonoy, to achieve atonement with it to send it to Azazel, in the desert.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the goat, on which the lot fell for ῾Azazel, shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make atonement over him, and to let him go to ῾Azazel into the wilderness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the he-goat on which the lot came up for Azazel shall be stood living before the L-rd [(whence it is derived that it is sent away for death)] to make atonement over it [i.e., to confess, viz. 21] to send it to Azazel to the desert.


###### Leviticus 16:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:11)


וְהִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־פַּ֤ר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֑וֹ וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall bring the sin-offering-bullock which is his and atone on his behalf and on behalf of his household, and he shall slaughter his sin-offering-bullock.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Aharon shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering which is his, and he shall make atonement over it for himself and for his household [(a second confession for himself and for his fellow Cohanim to atone for defiling of the sanctuary and of its holy objects, viz. 16)], and he shall slaughter the bullock of the sin-offering which is his.


###### Leviticus 16:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:12)


וְלָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא־הַ֠מַּחְתָּ֠ה גַּֽחֲלֵי־אֵ֞שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמְלֹ֣א חׇפְנָ֔יו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְהֵבִ֖יא מִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall take a full hand-shovel of fiery coals from atop the altar, which is before Adonoy and full handfuls of finely-ground incense and he shall bring [them] inside of the curtain.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the Lord, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it inside the veil:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall take a full coal-pan of coals of fire from off the [outer] altar before the L-rd [i.e., from the side which faces the door (of the mishkan), the west], and his full handfuls of incense of spices ground [especially] small, and he shall bring them within the parocheth.


###### Leviticus 16:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:13)


וְנָתַ֧ן אֶֽת־הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל־הָאֵ֖שׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכִסָּ֣ה**׀** עֲנַ֣ן הַקְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָעֵד֖וּת וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall put the incense on the fire before Adonoy and the cloud of incense will cover the Ark-cover that is on the [tablets of] Testimony, that he not die.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the covering that is upon the Testimony, that he die not:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall put the incense upon the fire [in the coal-pan] before the L-rd and the cloud of incense shall cover the kaporeth which is on the testimony, and he shall not die [(but, being remiss in this service, he is liable to death)].


###### Leviticus 16:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:14)


וְלָקַח֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֧ה בְאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָה וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע־פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן־הַדָּ֖ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall take some of the bullocks blood and he shall sprinkle with his finger, above the surface of the Ark-cover on its eastern part; and before the Ark-cover, he shall sprinkle, some blood, with his finger, seven times.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the covering eastward; and before the covering shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall take the blood of the bullock, and he shall sprinkle with his finger [one sprinkling] on the kaporeth, on the east, and before the kaporeth shall he sprinkle seven times of the blood with his finger. [Hence, "one above and seven below"].


###### Leviticus 16:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:15)


וְשָׁחַ֞ט אֶת־שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וְהֵבִיא֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ אֶל־מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶת־דָּמ֗וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְדַ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall slaughter the he-goat sin-offering that belongs to the people, and he shall bring its blood inside of the Curtain. He shall do [with] its blood just as he did with the bullocks blood and he shall sprinkle it on the Ark-cover and before of the Ark-cover.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring its blood within the veil, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the covering, and before the covering:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall slaughter the he-goat of the sin-offering which is the people's [(What the bullock atones for for the Cohanim, the he-goat "for the L-rd" atones for, for Israel)], and he shall bring its blood inside the parocheth. And he shall do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bullock [i.e., "one above and seven below"]; he shall sprinkle it on the kaporeth and before the kaporeth.


###### Leviticus 16:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:16)


וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַל־הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכׇל־חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְכֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַשֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He will atone for the Sanctuary, from the impurities of Bnei Yisroel and from their rebellious sins for all their transgressions. He shall do likewise for the Tent of Meeting, that dwells with them in the midst of their impurity.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yisra᾽el, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the Tent of Meeting, that remains among them in the midst of their uncleanness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall make atonement for the holy place from the uncleanlinesses of the children of Israel [for entering the sanctuary in a state of uncleanliness] and for their offenses [(willful entry in a state of uncleanliness)] for all of their transgressions [(unwitting entry in a state of uncleanliness without subsequent knowledge thereof)]. And so shall he do for the tent of meeting [(Just as he sprinkles of both within, one above and seven below, so he sprinkles of both on the parocheth outside, one above and seven below)], who dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanlinesses [(Though they be unclean, the Shechinah is with them)]


###### Leviticus 16:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:17)


וְכׇל־אָדָ֞ם לֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה**׀** בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד בְּבֹא֛וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד־צֵאת֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲדוֹ֙ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֔וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כׇּל־קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
No man shall be present in the Tent of Meeting when he comes in to atone for the Holy [Sanctuary] until he leaves. He shall atone on his behalf and on behalf of his household and on behalf of the entire assembly of Israel.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And there shall be no man in the Tent of Meeting when he goes in to make atonement in the holy place, until he comes out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And no man shall be in the tent of meeting when he comes to make atonement in the holy place until he goes out. And he shall make atonement for himself, and for his household, and for the entire congregation of Israel.


###### Leviticus 16:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:18)


וְיָצָ֗א אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵֽי־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְלָקַ֞ח מִדַּ֤ם הַפָּר֙ וּמִדַּ֣ם הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־קַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall go out to the altar that is before Adonoy and atone on it. He shall take some of the bullocks blood and some of the he-goats blood and put it atop the corners of the altar, all around.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall go out to the altar that is before the Lord, and make atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall go out to the [golden] altar which is before the L-rd [after having stood inwards of the altar to sprinkle on the parocheth], and he shall make atonement on it — he shall take from the blood of the bullock and from the blood of the he-goat [intermixed] and he shall place it on the horns of the altar roundabout [beginning with the northeast corner].


###### Leviticus 16:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:19)


וְהִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧יו מִן־הַדָּ֛ם בְּאֶצְבָּע֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִהֲר֣וֹ וְקִדְּשׁ֔וֹ מִטֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall sprinkle on it from the blood that is on his finger seven times and purify it and sanctify it from the impurities of Bnei Yisroel.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall sprinkle upon it [on its top] with his finger seven times, and he shall cleanse it [from past uncleanlinesses], and he shall hallow it [for the future] from the uncleanlinesses of the children of Israel.


###### Leviticus 16:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:20)


וְכִלָּה֙ מִכַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְהִקְרִ֖יב אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֥יר הֶחָֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
When he finishes atoning for the Holy [Sanctuary] and [for] the Tent of Meeting and [for] the altar he shall bring the live he-goat.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And when he has made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when he has finished making atonement for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, then he shall draw near the living he-goat.


###### Leviticus 16:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:21)


וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֗ו עַ֣ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר֮ הַחַי֒ וְהִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗יו אֶת־כׇּל־עֲוֺנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־כׇּל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכׇל־חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְנָתַ֤ן אֹתָם֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשִׁלַּ֛ח בְּיַד־אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Aharon shall lay his two hands on the head of the live he-goat and confess on it all the iniquities of Bnei Yisroel and all their rebellious transgressions for all their sins, and put them on the head of the goat and send it away with the man [so] designated, to the desert.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and Aharon shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Yisra᾽el, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of an appointed man into the wilderness:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Aaron shall place his two hands on the head of the living he-goat, and he shall confess over it all the transgressions of the children of Israel, and all their offenses of all their sins, and he shall place them on the head of the he-goat, and he shall send it by the hand of a readied man [readied from the day before] to the desert.


###### Leviticus 16:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/16:22)


וְנָשָׂ֨א הַשָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אֶת־כׇּל־עֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֖יר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The goat shall carry upon itself all of their iniquities to a desolate land, and [the man shall] send the goat into the desert.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the goat shall bear upon it all their iniquities to a barren land: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the he-goat shall bear upon itself all of their transgressions to an uninhabited land, and he shall send out the he-goat in the desert. [Verse 24 is understood as following at this point.]


###### Leviticus 16:23

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they shall sacrifice no more their sacrifices to the satyrs [demons], after which they go astray. An everlasting statute shall this be to them throughout their generations.

and not bring it to the door of the tent of meeting to offer it to the L-rd, that man shall be cut off from his people [(His seed shall be cut off and his days shall be cut off)].


###### Leviticus 17:10

וְאִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמִן־הַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאכַ֖ל כׇּל־דָּ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֣י פָנַ֗י בַּנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ הָאֹכֶ֣לֶת אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Each and every person of the House of Israel and from the proselyte who resides among them who will eat any blood; I shall direct my anger on the soul of him who eats the blood and I will cut it off from among its people.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And whatever man there be of the house of Yisra᾽el, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eats any manner of blood: then I will set my face against that person that eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a man from the house of Israel and from the stranger that dwells in their midst that shall eat any blood [(not only that of kodshim)] — I shall direct My regard to that soul which eats the blood, and I shall cut it off from the midst of its people.


###### Leviticus 17:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/17:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/17:11)


כִּ֣י נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר֮ בַּדָּ֣ם הִוא֒ וַאֲנִ֞י נְתַתִּ֤יו לָכֶם֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־הַדָּ֥ם ה֖וּא בַּנֶּ֥פֶשׁ יְכַפֵּֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For [the] soul of the body is in the blood and I have given it to you [to be placed] on the altar to achieve atonement for your souls, for it is the blood that will achieve atonement for the soul.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that makes an atonement for the soul.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the life of [all] flesh is in the blood, wherefore I have given it to you upon the altar to atone for your lives; for it is the blood which atones for the life ["A life (the animal's) for a life"].


###### Leviticus 17:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/17:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/17:12)


עַל־כֵּ֤ן אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כׇּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ מִכֶּ֖ם לֹא־תֹ֣אכַל דָּ֑ם וְהַגֵּ֛ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶ֖ם לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל דָּֽם׃

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

וְאִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמִן־הַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצ֜וּד צֵ֥יד חַיָּ֛ה אוֹ־ע֖וֹף אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֑ל וְשָׁפַךְ֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ וְכִסָּ֖הוּ בֶּעָפָֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And whatever man there be of the children of Yisra᾽el, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, who hunts venison of any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall even pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a man of the children of Israel and of the stranger that dwells in their midst, that shall hunt a hunting [(even if not actually "hunted")] of animal or bird that may be eaten [(unclean animals are excluded from what follows)], he shall pour out its blood and cover it with earth.


###### Leviticus 17:14

כִּֽי־נֶ֣פֶשׁ כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֗ר דָּמ֣וֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ֮ הוּא֒ וָֽאֹמַר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּ֥ם כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֖ר לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ כִּ֣י נֶ֤פֶשׁ כׇּל־בָּשָׂר֙ דָּמ֣וֹ הִ֔וא כׇּל־אֹכְלָ֖יו יִכָּרֵֽת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For [as to] the life of all flesh, its blood is its life, and I have said to Bnei Yisroel: The blood of any flesh, you should not eat, for, the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats of it, shall be cut off.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the life of all flesh is its blood, on which its life depends: therefore I said to the children of Yisra᾽el, you shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is its blood: whoever eats it shall be cut off.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the life of all flesh — its blood is in [place of] its life [i.e., its life is dependent upon its blood]. And I have said to the children of Israel: The blood of all flesh you shall not eat; for the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.


###### Leviticus 17:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/17:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/17:15)


וְכׇל־נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֤ל נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה בָּאֶזְרָ֖ח וּבַגֵּ֑ר וְכִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Anybody that will eat an improperly slaughtered animal or an animal with a fatal defect among the native-born and the proselyte, shall wash his clothing and bathe in water and is impure until the evening, and [then] becomes purified.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And every person that eats that which died of itself, or that which was torn by beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until evening: then shall he be clean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And every soul that eats neveilah (carcass) or treifah (what is "torn") [(Scripture speaks here of the neveilah of a clean fowl)], whether citizen or stranger, he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening, and then he shall be clean.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 18

###### Leviticus 18:1

וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord spoke to Moshe, saying,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd spoke to Moses, saying:


###### Leviticus 18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:2)


דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them I am Adonoy, your God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Speak to the children of Yisra᾽el, and say to them, I am the Lord your God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Speak to the children of Israel and say to them: I am the L-rd your G-d [I am He who said in Sinai: "I am the L-rd your G-d," and you accepted My kingdom upon you; now accept My decrees.]


###### Leviticus 18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:3)


כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֧ה אֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּם־בָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶתְכֶ֥ם שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵֽכוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
After the practice of the Land of Egypt in which you have lived, you shall not do, and the practice of the Land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you, you shall not do and you shall not follow their statutes [customs].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
After the doings of the land of Miżrayim, in which you dwelt, shall you not do: and after the doings of the land of Kena῾an, into which I bring you, shall you not do: neither shall you walk in their practices.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As the deeds of the land of Egypt in which you dwelt you shall not do; and as the deeds of the land of Canaan, [(the Egyptians and Canaanites being the most corrupt of the peoples, and the place where Israel dwelt being the most corrupt of all)], to which I bring you [(those peoples conquered by Israel being the most corrupt of all)], you shall not do, and in their statutes [(i.e., in their customs, things which have become like "statutes" for them, like frequenting theaters and stadia)], you shall not walk.


###### Leviticus 18:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:4)


אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֧י תַּעֲשׂ֛וּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall fulfill My laws and you shall keep My statutes to follow them, I am Adonoy, your God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall do my judgments, and keep my ordinances, to walk in them, I am the Lord your God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My judgments shall you do [("judgments"): "just" things, which, even if they had not been stated, would have warranted observance)], and My statutes shall you keep to walk in them [("statutes"): decrees of the King, "questioned" by the evil inclination and by the nations of the world, such as (the interdictions against) the eating of pig and the wearing of sha'atnez (a mixture of wool and linen), and the purification effected by the waters of the red heifer. ("to walk in them"): Do not exempt yourself from them by saying: "I have learned the wisdom of Israel; I shall now go and learn the wisdom of the nations"]; I am the L-rd your G-d [My decree is upon you and you are not at liberty to exempt yourself from it.]


###### Leviticus 18:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:5)


וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall keep My statutes and My laws which if a man obeys he shall live through them; I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall keep My statutes and My judgments [(including what may be deduced, though not explicitly stated)], which a man shall do, and he shall live by them [in the world to come]; I am the L-rd [trusted to reward].


###### Leviticus 18:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:6)


אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אֶל־כׇּל־שְׁאֵ֣ר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִקְרְב֖וּ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָ֑ה אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Each and every person—to any of his close kin—You shall not approach to uncover [their] nakedness, I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover her nakedness: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A man, to all the kin of his flesh shall not draw near [(lo tikrevu, plural, women being exhorted as well as men)] to uncover nakedness (i.e., to cohabit); I am the L-rd [trusted to reward].


###### Leviticus 18:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:7)


עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛יךָ וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The nakedness of your father and the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover; she is your mother, you shall not uncover her nakedness.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The nakedness of your father [i.e., your father's wife] and the nakedness of your mother, [though she not be your father's wife], you shall not reveal. She is your mother; you shall not reveal her nakedness.


###### Leviticus 18:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:8)


עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The nakedness of your fathers wife you shall not uncover; it is your fathers nakedness.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The nakedness of the wife of your father, [even after his death], you shall not reveal; it is your father's nakedness.


###### Leviticus 18:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:9)


עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲחֽוֹתְךָ֤ בַת־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת בַּ֔יִת א֖וֹ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת ח֑וּץ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽן׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The nakedness of your sister [whether she is] your fathers daughter or your mothers daughter; whether she is born in the house, or she is born outside, you shall not uncover their nakedness.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, [even by a woman that he ravished], or the daughter of your mother, whether she be born [of a woman that he is permitted to keep] at home [as a wife], or born [of a woman that he is commanded to send] outside [such as a mamzereth or a nethinah] — you shall not uncover their nakedness.


###### Leviticus 18:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/18:10)


עֶרְוַ֤ת בַּת־בִּנְךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַֽת־בִּתְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָ֑ן כִּ֥י עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ הֵֽנָּה׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The nakedness of your sons daughter or your daughters daughter; you shall not uncover their nakedness, for their nakedness is your own.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thy own nakedness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The nakedness of the daughter of your son [(even) by a woman that you ravished] or the daughter of your daughter [(even) by a woman that you ravished], you shall not reveal their nakedness; for they are your nakedness.


###### Leviticus 18:11

עֶרְוַ֨ת בַּת־אֵ֤שֶׁת אָבִ֙יךָ֙ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת אָבִ֔יךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ֖ הִ֑וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The nakedness of the daughter of your fathers wife who is born to your father; she is your sister, you shall not uncover her nakedness.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The nakedness of the daughter of your father's wife, [one fit to be a "wife," not a bondswoman or a gentile], begotten of your father — she is your sister; you shall not reveal her nakedness.

The nakedness of your brothers wife you shall not uncover; it is your brothers nakedness.

The nakedness of a [(halachically) married] woman and her daughter you shall not uncover [(But one is permitted to marry the daughter of a woman he ravished)]. The daughter of her son and the daughter of her daughter you shall not take to reveal her nakedness. They are kin; it is scheming.
