###### Leviticus 19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:3)


אִ֣ישׁ אִמּ֤וֹ וְאָבִיו֙ תִּירָ֔אוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A man—you shall fear his mother and father and keep My Sabbaths, I am Adonoy, your God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A man, his mother and his father shall you fear, [("mother" is stated before "father" because a man normally fears his father more than he does his mother)], and My Sabbaths shall you keep [(If parents bid their children to transgress mitzvoth, they are not to be heeded)]: I am the L-rd your G-d [(Both you and your parents are obliged to honor Me.)] [What is "fear"? Not sitting in his place, not speaking in his stead, not contradicting his words.]


###### Leviticus 19:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:4)


אַל־תִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלִילִ֔ם וֵֽאלֹהֵי֙ מַסֵּכָ֔ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Do not turn to the idols and do not make molten gods for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Turn not to idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not turn to the elilim [(lit., "non-entities") to serve them], and molten gods [(If you turn to them, you will make them gods)] do not make for yourselves [(neither you for others nor others for you)]; I am the L-rd your G-d.


###### Leviticus 19:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:5)


וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהֹוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
When you slaughter a peace-offering to Adonoy, you shall slaughter it to be acceptable for you.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if you offer a sacrifice of peace offering to the Lord, you shall offer it so that it may be favourably accepted.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when you slaughter a sacrifice of peace-offerings to the L-rd — so that you find favor [with it in the eyes of the L-rd] shall you slaughter it.


###### Leviticus 19:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:6)


בְּי֧וֹם זִבְחֲכֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּמִֽמׇּחֳרָ֑ת וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ עַד־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
On the day that it is slaughtered it may be eaten and on the next day. Whatever is left over by the third day shall be burned in fire.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in fire.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[i.e., Slaughter it with the intent that] it will be eaten on the day that you sacrifice it and on the morrow, and (that) what remains of it [nothar] on the third day will be burned with fire [as indicated in 7:16-17].


###### Leviticus 19:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:7)


וְאִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And if it should be eaten at all on the third day it is an abomination, it will not be favorably accepted.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if it is eaten on the third day [(exegetically, if it is eaten outside of its prescribed place)], it is piggul ["abhorrent"]; it shall not be accepted.


###### Leviticus 19:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:8)


וְאֹֽכְלָיו֙ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי־אֶת־קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהֹוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Whoever eats from it shall bear his iniquity, for the sacred [things] of Adonoy he has defiled. That [persons] soul shall be cut off from its people.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore everyone that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shalt be cut off from among his people.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the eater of it [absolute nothar] shall bear his sin, for he has profaned the holy thing of the L-rd; and that soul shall be cut off from its people.


###### Leviticus 19:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:9)


וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם֙ אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְךָ֖ לִקְצֹ֑ר וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
When you will reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap a corner of your field, and the gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And when you reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when you cut the harvest of your land, do not end off the corner (peah) of your field to cut it; and the gleaning (leket) of your harvest, [one or two ears (but not more) which fall to the ground during reaping] you shall not gather.


###### Leviticus 19:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:10)


וְכַרְמְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּפֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not glean your vineyard, and the fallen grapes of your vineyard, you shall not gather. For the poor and the proselyte you shall leave them, I am Adonoy, your God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the single grapes of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And your vineyard you shall not glean [You shall not take the oleiloth (tendrils which have no grapes bunched together or hanging down from the end)]; and the fallen fruit (peret) of your vineyard [single grapes which fall to the ground at the time of reaping] you shall not gather. To the poor man and to the stranger you shall leave them; I am the L-rd your G-d [a Judge, exacting punishment (of those who steal from the poor)].


###### Leviticus 19:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:11)


לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְלֹא־תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not steal. You shall not deny [a rightful claim] and each one of you shall not lie to each other.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not steal [(an exhortation against stealing money)], and you shall not deny [(an exhortation towards the payment of the principal and the fifth in an instance of denial (5:22)], and you shall not lie one to another [(an exhortation towards the payment of the principal and the fifth in an instance of swearing falsely). If you steal, you will come to deny, to lie, and to swear falsely.]


###### Leviticus 19:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:12)


וְלֹֽא־תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not swear falsely by My Name profaning the Name of your God, I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And you shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall not swear in My name [(even by an epithet)] falsely and (thereby) profane the name of your G-d; I am the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 19:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:13)


לֹֽא־תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת־רֵֽעֲךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא־תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not withhold the wages of your fellow [Jew] and you shall not rob. It shall not remain overnight, the wages of a day-laborer, keeping it in your possession until morning.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not oppress your neighbor [(This alludes to holding back the wages of a hired worker)], and you shall not rob. There shall not abide with you the wages of a [day] laborer until [the next] morning.


###### Leviticus 19:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:14)


לֹא־תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְלִפְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not curse a deaf person and before a blind person you shall not place a stumbling-block; you shall fear your God, I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not curse the deaf man [(i.e., any man who is alive)], and before the blind man [i.e., one who is "blind" in a certain matter], do not place a stumbling-block. And you shall fear your G-d, [who knows your intentions]; I am the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 19:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:15)


לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֙וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not commit injustice in judgement, you shall not favor a poor man and you shall not show honor to a powerful man. With righteousness shall you judge your fellow [Jew].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not do wrong in judgment [(A judge who perverts justice is called "wrong," "hated," "revolting," "rejected," "abominable")]. You shall not lift up the face of the poor man [Do not say: He is poor and the rich man is obliged to sustain him; I shall vindicate him in judgment so that he can support himself honorably.], and you shall not favor the face of the great one [Do not say: He is a wealthy man, the son of great ones; how can I shame him and look on at his shame!] In righteousness shall you judge your neighbor.


###### Leviticus 19:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:16)


לֹא־תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑ךָ¹ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃

footnotes:
¹ (בכתר ארם צובה היה כתוב רֵעֶ֑יךָ)


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Do not be a tale-bearer among your people. You shall not stand idly by [when] the blood (life) of your fellow [is in danger]. I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand aside when mischief befalls thy neighbour: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not go spying out among your people [with an eye to slandering]. You shall not stand by the blood of your neighbor, [watching him die, when you can help him]; I am the L-rd, [trusted to reward and trusted to exact punishment].


###### Leviticus 19:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:17)


לֹֽא־תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֙יחַ֙ אֶת־עֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖יו חֵֽטְא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not hate your brother in your heart; You shall certainly rebuke your friend; [but] you shall not bear a sin on his account.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt certainly rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin on his account.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not hate your brother in your heart. Reprove shall you reprove your neighbor, but do not bear sin because of him [(Do not shame him in public)].


###### Leviticus 19:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:18)


לֹֽא־תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not take revenge or bear a grudge against the children of your people. You shall love your fellow [Jew] as yourself, I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall not take revenge [e.g., "You did not lend me; I will not lend you!"], and you shall not bear a grudge against the children of your people [e.g.. "I am not like you who did not lend me; I shall lend you!"]. And you shall love your neighbor as yourself. [(R. Akiva said: This is an all-embracing principle in Torah)]; I am the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 19:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:19)


אֶֽת־חֻקֹּתַי֮ תִּשְׁמֹ֒רוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְךָ֖ לֹא־תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּבֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֙יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Keep My statutes; Do not cross-breed your animals with different species. Do not sow your field with a mixture of different seeds. A garment that contains *shatnez* [a forbidden mixture of linen and wool] you shall not wear.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and wool come upon thee.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My statutes (chukim), [which follow,] shall you keep [chukim are "decrees of the King," for which no reasons are given]: You shall not mate your beast with a diverse kind (kilayim); your field you shall not sow with diverse seeds (kilayim), and a mingled (kilayim, interwoven) garment (sha'atnez) shall not come upon you ["sha'atnez" — felt-stuff (of wool and linen) mingled. Acronymically, "shua" (hackled), "tavui" (spun), "nuz" (twined)].


###### Leviticus 19:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:20)


וְ֠אִ֠ישׁ כִּֽי־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ וְהׇפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖הֿ לֹ֣א נִתַּן־לָ֑הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If a man lies with a woman in a conjugal manner, and she is a maid-servant designated for a [specific] man and she has certainly not been redeemed, or her freedom was not given to her; there shall be an investigation they shall not be put to death, for her freedom was not given to her.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And whoever lies carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, designated to a man, and not wholly redeemed, nor freedom given her; inquiry shall be made; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a man, if he lie with a woman, a lying of seed, and she be a [Canaanite] maidservant [half bondswoman-half freewoman]; bound [i.e., betrothed] to a man [a Hebrew bondsman], and she has not been redeemed [with money], or freedom has not been given to her [by writ], she shall be inquired after [towards her (but not his) receiving stripes]. They shall not be put to death, for she was not freed [(But if she had been freed, the betrothal is bona fide, and the death penalty obtains)].


###### Leviticus 19:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:21)


וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall bring his guilt-offering to Adonoy, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a guilt-offering-ram.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall bring his guilt offering to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, a ram for a guilt offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he (the man who lay with her) shall bring his guilt-offering to the L-rd, to the door of the tent of meeting, a ram for a guilt-offering.


###### Leviticus 19:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/19:22)


וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן בְּאֵ֤יל הָֽאָשָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֔וֹ מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃{פ}

The *kohein* shall atone for him with the guilt-offering-ram before Adonoy for the sin which he committed and he will be forgiven for the sin which he committed.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

And the Cohein shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt-offering before the L-rd for his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him for his sin which he has sinned [(deliberate as well as unwitting)].

###### Leviticus 20:5

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go astray after him, going astray after Molekh, from among their people.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then I shall direct My regard to that man and to his family, [who "cover up" for him], and I will cut him off, [him with kareth; his family, with afflictions], and all who go astray after him to stray after the Molech [(Subsumed in this are other idols served in the manner of Molech though that not be their normal mode of worship)] (I will cut off) from the midst of their people.

וָאֹמַ֣ר לָכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֮ תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אַדְמָתָם֒ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתְּנֶ֤נָּה לָכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֹתָ֔הּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֲנִי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִן־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And I have said to you [that] you shall inherit their land, and I shall give it to you that you may inherit it, a land flowing with milk and honey, I am Adonoy, your God who separated you from the [other] peoples.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I have said to you, You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land that flows with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God, who have separated you from the peoples.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said to you: You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to inherit, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the L-rd your G-d who separated you from the peoples.


###### Leviticus 20:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/20:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/20:25)


וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּ֞ם בֵּֽין־הַבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּהֹרָה֙ לַטְּמֵאָ֔ה וּבֵין־הָע֥וֹף הַטָּמֵ֖א לַטָּהֹ֑ר וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת־נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֜ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבָע֗וֹף וּבְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי לָכֶ֖ם לְטַמֵּֽא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall distinguish between a [ritually] clean animal and a unclean one, between the unclean fowl and the clean one. Do not make yourselves disgusting through the animals, fowl or through any creature that creeps on the ground which I have distinguished for you as being unclean.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall therefore distinguish between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean birds and clean: and you shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by any manner of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall separate between the clean beast and the unclean [i.e., between that which is clean for you and that which is unclean, between the severing of the majority of the shechitah sign (in which instance the animal is kasher) and the severing of half (in which instance it is treifah)], and between the unclean fowl and the clean; and you shall not make yourselves despicable through the beast or the fowl, or through anything with which the ground swarms, which I have separated for you as unclean [i.e., as forbidden].


###### Leviticus 20:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/20:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/20:26)


וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וָאַבְדִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִן־הָֽעַמִּ֖ים לִהְי֥וֹת לִֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall be holy to Me, for I, Adonoy, am holy and I have distinguished you from the [other] peoples to be Mine [and to serve Me].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And you shall be holy to me: for I the Lord am holy, and have separated you from the peoples, that you should be mine.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall be holy unto Me, for I, the L-rd, am holy; and I have set you apart from the peoples to be Mine [If you are separate from them, you are Mine; if not, you are "Nevuchadnezzar's."]


###### Leviticus 20:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/20:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/20:27)


וְאִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּי־יִהְיֶ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ בָּאֶ֛בֶן יִרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If among the men or women there will be a medium or an oracle they shall surely be put to death. You shall stone them to death, their blood is on them.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A man also or woman that is a medium or a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a man or a woman if there be in them an ov or yidoni, they shall be put to death. With stones shall they stone them; their blood is in them. [Where there are witnesses and warning — stoning; wittingness, without warning — kareth; unwittingness — a sin-offering. The same applies to all transgressions punishable by death where "kareth" is stated.]



## Chapter 21

###### Leviticus 21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:1)


וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא־יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּעַמָּֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy said to Moshe; speak, to the *kohanim*, the sons of Aharon, and you shall say to them, let him not defile himself with the dead among his people.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord said to Moshe, Speak to the priests the sons of Aharon, and say to them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd said to Moses: Speak to the Cohanim, [(excluding chalalim, those unfit to minister)], the sons of Aaron, [(even those with blemishes) (and not the daughters of Aaron)], and say to them [(adults being exhorted in respect to minors)]: For a dead body he (a Cohein) shall not become unclean among his people [i.e., when the dead one is "among his people," excluding a meth mitzvah (one who has no one else to bury him)].


###### Leviticus 21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:2)


כִּ֚י אִם־לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Except to his kin to whom he is closely related, for his mother and his father, for his son, his daughter and for his brother.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
but for his kin, that is near to him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son and for his daughter, and for his brother,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Only for his flesh [his wife] that is near to him, his mother and his father, his son and his daughter and his brother.


###### Leviticus 21:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:3)


וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַבְּתוּלָה֙ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הָיְתָ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
For his virgin sister, to whom he is closely related, who has not yet been married, for her, he may be defiled.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and for his sister a virgin, that is near to him, and who has had no husband; for her may he be defiled.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And for his sister, the virgin, who is near to him [(including one who is betrothed)], who was not wed to a man [for cohabitation] — for her shall he make himself unclean.


###### Leviticus 21:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:4)


לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּ֖א בַּ֣עַל בְּעַמָּ֑יו לְהֵ֖חַלּֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A husband may not defile himself among his people [for a wife through whom] he becomes profaned.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A husband (who is a Cohein) shall not defile himself [for his wife when she is] in [the midst of] his people [i.e., when there are others to bury her (in which instance she is not a meth mitzvah). (And the wife spoken of here is one)] through whom he is profaned [(made a chalal) by living with her].


###### Leviticus 21:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:5)


לֹֽא־[יִקְרְח֤וּ] (יקרחה) קׇרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They shall not make baldness on their heads and the corners of their beards they shall not shave, and they shall not make gashes in their flesh.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall not make baldness on their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They shall not make a baldness upon their head [for one who dies], and the corner of their beard they shall not shave off [with a razor], and in their flesh they shall not make any cutting [(There is liability for each cutting.)]


###### Leviticus 21:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:6)


קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They shall be holy to their God and they shall not profane the Name of their God, for [it is] the fire-offerings of Adonoy, the bread of their God [that] they bring [offer], and they must [therefore] be holy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Holy shall they be, [perforce. Beth-din compels them to remain holy (i.e., not to make themselves unclean)] to their G-d, and they shall not profane the name of their G-d; for the fire-offerings of the L-rd, the bread of their G-d, they offer up — and they shall be holy.


###### Leviticus 21:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:7)


אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי־קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A harlot or a profaned woman they shall not marry. A woman divorced from her husband they shall not marry, for he is holy to his God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall not take a wife that is a harlot, or profaned; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy to his God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A woman who is a harlot or profaned (chalalah) [a woman born of those unfit for the priesthood, e.g., the daughter of a widow by a high-priest, or of a divorced woman by an ordinary priest, or a woman who cohabited with one unfit for the priesthood] they shall not take; for he is holy to his G-d.


###### Leviticus 21:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:8)


וְקִ֨דַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make him holy for he offers the bread of your God; he shall be holy unto you for I, Adonoy, am holy, Who makes you holy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of thy God: he shall be holy to thee: for I the Lord, who sanctify you, am holy.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall make him holy, [perforce. (If he refuses to divorce her, lash him and afflict him until he does so)], for he offers up the bread of your G-d; holy shall he be unto you [(Relate to him with holiness, having him initiate all things and giving him precedence in blessing at the meal)], for holy am I the L-rd, who sanctifies you.


###### Leviticus 21:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:9)


וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־אָבִ֙יהָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The daughter of a *kohein*, who profanes herself by fornication—she profanes her father— she shall be burned with fire.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profanes her father: she shall be burnt with fire.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the [betrothed or married] daughter of a man who is a Cohein, if she profane herself through fornication, she profanes her father [(They say about him: "Cursed be he who begot such as she! Cursed be he who raised such as she!")]; in fire shall she be burned.


###### Leviticus 21:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:10)


וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲֽשֶׁר־יוּצַ֥ק עַל־רֹאשׁ֣וֹ**׀** שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* who is greatest among his brethren upon whose head was poured the anointing oil; whose hands were consecrated to put on the special garments; shall not let his hair grow wild and he shall not tear his garments.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not suffer the hair of his head to grow long, nor rend his clothes;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein who is greater than his brothers (i.e., the high-priest), upon whose head the oil of anointment has been poured, and who has been invested to wear the garments — his hair he shall not grow long [for more than thirty days (in mourning)] and his clothes he shall not rend.


###### Leviticus 21:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:11)


וְעַ֛ל כׇּל־נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And adjacent to any dead body he shall not enter. For his father and mother he shall not become [ritually] impure.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And to any (kol) dead body [(kol) including a revi'ith of blood of a dead person, which causes uncleanliness in a tent)] he shall not come [(into the tent of the dead)]. For his father and for his mother he shall not become unclean, [but he may become unclean for a meth mitzvah].


###### Leviticus 21:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:12)


וּמִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall not depart from the Sanctuary and he shall not profane his Gods Sanctuary, for the crown of his Gods anointing oil is upon him, I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And from the sanctuary he shall not go out [He does not follow the litter, and he sacrifices even when he is an onein (before the burial)], and he does not profane the sanctuary of his G-d [thereby (But an ordinary Cohein who serves when he is an onein does)], for the crown of the anointing oil of his G-d is upon him; I am the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 21:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:13)


וְה֕וּא אִשָּׁ֥ה בִבְתוּלֶ֖יהָ יִקָּֽח׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall marry [only] a virgin.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall take a wife in her virginity.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he, a woman in her virginity he shall take.


###### Leviticus 21:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:14)


אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A widow, divorcee, profaned woman or harlot; he may not marry [any] of these. But only a virgin from his own people may he marry.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A widow, or a divorced woman, or a profaned, or a harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A widow, and a divorced woman, and a chalalah [a woman born of those unfit for the priesthood], (and) a harlot — these he shall not take; but only a virgin from his people shall he take as a wife.


###### Leviticus 21:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:15)


וְלֹֽא־יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Adonoy, who makes him holy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall not profane his seed among his people [(If he does take one of them, his child is a chalal)]; for I am the L-rd who makes him holy.


###### Leviticus 21:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/21:16)

###### Leviticus 22:12

Take the blasphemer beyond the encampment, and all those who heard him shall lay their hands on his head and the entire congregation shall stone him.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Bring forth him that has cursed outside the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Take the curser outside the camp, and let all [(including the judges)], who heard [(These are the witnesses)] place their hands on his head [(They say to him: Your blood is on your own head, and not upon us; you brought it upon yourself)], and let all the congregation stone him [i.e., let him be stoned in the presence of the entire congregation (whence it is derived that one's emissary is like himself)].

Or his uncle, or his uncle's son shall redeem him; or those of his near of kin, of his family, shall redeem him; or, if his hand attain, he shall be redeemed (by himself).


###### Leviticus 25:50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/25:50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/25:50)


וְחִשַּׁב֙ עִם־קֹנֵ֔הוּ מִשְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְרוֹ ל֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְהָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמּֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall reckon with the one who bought him. [According to the number of years] from the year which he was sold to him until the jubilee year. His purchase price shall be [proportional] to the number of years; at the rate of the days of a hired hand it shall be [considered as he worked] with him.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he was sold to him to the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years, according to the time of a hired servant shall it be with him.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall reckon with his buyer [(Even if the gentile who bought him be subservient to you, make a "straight reckoning" with him (to avoid desecration of the Name)], from the year that he was sold to him until the Jubilee year, [when he would, in any event, be released]. And the money of his selling will be according to the number of years [that he served him]. According to the days of a hired man shall he be with him [i.e., the buyer receives the difference between the purchase price and the wages of a hired man for the period that he serves him (that wage being determined proportionately, per year, by the purchase price divided by the number of years until the Jubilee year)].


###### Leviticus 25:51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/25:51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/25:51)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If there are yet many years [until the jubilee] accordingly shall he return his redemption money from his purchase price.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If there are yet many years, according to them he shall restore the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If there are yet many in the years [until the Jubilee year], according to them shall he return his redemption (money) from the money of his acquisition.


###### Leviticus 25:52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/25:52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/25:52)


וְאִם־מְעַ֞ט נִשְׁאַ֧ר בַּשָּׁנִ֛ים עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל וְחִשַּׁב־ל֑וֹ כְּפִ֣י שָׁנָ֔יו יָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If there remain but a few years until the jubilee year, he shall make a [similar] calculation, based on the number of years he shall return his redemption money [to the purchaser.]


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if there remain but few years until the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him, and according to his years shall he restore the price of his redemption.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if few are left in the years until the Jubilee year, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years shall he return his redemption.

As a hired hand [working] on a yearly basis shall he be considered with him; he shall not rule over him to crush him before your eyes.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As a hired man, year by year, shall he be with him; he shall not rule over him oppressively before your eyes.

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If he is not redeemed through these means he then goes out in the jubilee year, he, along with his children.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 26

###### Leviticus 26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/26:1)


לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall not make idols for yourselves and graven images and memorial stones you shall not raise up for youselves, and a prostration stone you shall not set in your land upon which to prostrate oneself, for I am Adonoy, your God.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall make no idols, nor shall you erect a carved idol, or a pillar, nor shall you install a figured stone in your land, to bow down upon it: for I am the Lord your God.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[The following is addressed to a Jew who sold himself to a gentile, and who might come to say: Since my master serves idols, I, likewise, may do so, etc.] You shall not make for yourselves idols, and a graven image or a pillar you shall not upraise for yourselves, and a covering stone [(a stone pavement covering the ground)] shall you not make in your land to prostrate (yourselves) upon it [even unto Heaven (this being permitted only in the Temple)], for I am the L-rd your G-d.


###### Leviticus 26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/26:2)


אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall keep My Shabbosos and you shall fear (revere) My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary, I am the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My Sabbaths shall you keep, and My sanctuary shall you fear; I am the L-rd [trusted to reward].

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/26:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/26:3)


אִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If you follow My statutes and keep My commandments and you will fulfill them,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If in My statutes you walk [i.e., If in My Torah you toil], and My mitzvoth you keep [that is, if you toil in My Torah in order to keep My mitzvoth and to fulfill them], and you do them,

then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then I shall give your rains in their [proper] times [i.e., when people are not generally found out of doors], and the earth will yield its produce and the tree of the field [i.e., the normally barren tree] will yield its fruit.


###### Leviticus 26:5

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And your threshing [will be so abundant that it] will reach for you [until] the [time of the] vintage [harvest] and the vintage will reach the sowing, and you will eat your bread to satiety [i.e., you will eat but little, and the food will be "blessed" in your innards], and you will dwell secure in your land.

And [(lest you say: Food and drink without peace is nothing)], I will put peace, [which is over and against all,] in the land, and you will lie down and not tremble; and I will eliminate evil beasts from the land, and a sword shall not pass through your land, [even a sword of "peace" (i.e., an army passing through Eretz Yisrael to attack a different land)].

###### Leviticus 26:15

וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If it is of an unclean animal, he shall redeem it based on the valuation, and add a fifth to [that amount]. If it is not redeemed, it shall be sold according to the valuation.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to the estimation, and shall add to it a fifth part of it: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to the estimation.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if (he wishes to redeem) an unclean beast [that he dedicated to bedek habayith (Temple maintenance)], then he shall redeem it according to the valuation [i.e., according to the Cohein's assessment], and he shall add its fifth upon it. And if it is not redeemed [by the owner], then it shall be sold by the valuation [to others].


###### Leviticus 27:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:28)


אַךְ־כׇּל־חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהֹוָ֜ה מִכׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כׇּל־חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קׇדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
However, any dedication that a man will dedicate to Adonoy from any of his belongings be it people (slave), or animal, or of the field of his ancestral land, [none of these] can be sold or redeemed. Everything that is dedicated is most holy, unto Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to the Lord of all that he has, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[There are two possible readings for this verse, one, (28a) according to those who hold that unspecified devotions (stam charamim) go to the Cohanim; the other, (28b) according to those who hold that they go to hekdesh (Temple maintenance)]


###### Leviticus 27:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:29)


כׇּל־חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יׇחֳרַ֛ם מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Any dedication that a man will dedcate, regarding a man [due to be put to death] cannot be redeemed, he shall surely be put to death.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
None devoted of men, which shall be doomed to death, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Any cherem that is devoted from a man [i.e., from a man going out to be executed (an observer saying: "I vow to give the valuation of that man")] shall not be redeemed, [for] he is going to be put to death [(and has no valuation)].


###### Leviticus 27:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:30)


וְכׇל־מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהֹוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
All tithings of the land; whether of the seeds [crops] of the land or of the fruit of the tree, belongs to Adonoy, it is sacred to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord’s: it is holy to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And all the tithe of the land [second-tithe (ma'aser sheni)], of the seed of the land [i.e., grain], of the fruit of the tree [wine and oil], belong to the L-rd [and He has commanded you (Deuteronomy 14:23) to go up and eat it "from His table" in Jerusalem]; it is holy to the L-rd.


###### Leviticus 27:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:31)


וְאִם־גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If a man wishes to redeem of his tithe, he shall add a fifth to [the amount].


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And if a man will at all redeem of his tithes, he shall add to it the fifth part of it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if a man would redeem of his tithe [to permit him to eat it anywhere, (and with the redemption money he buys food in Jerusalem, which he eats there)], then he shall add its fifth upon it [(but if he redeems his neighbor's tithe, he need not add a fifth)].


###### Leviticus 27:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:32)


וְכׇל־מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
All tithes of cattle and sheep, anything that passes under the rod, the tenth one shall be sacred to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, of whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And all the tithe of herd or flock, whatever passes under the staff [(He would strike every tenth animal (passing in a row) with a staff painted red)], the tenth shall be holy to the L-rd [(The blood and eimurin are offered on the altar, and the flesh is eaten by the owner)].


###### Leviticus 27:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:33)


לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין־ט֥וֹב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה־ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall not make a distinction between better or worse [animals] and he shall not exchange it. If he exchanges one for another, then [both] it and its replacement shall be sacred and it cannot be redeemed.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He shall not discriminate (in tithing) between good [unblemished] or bad [blemished. (Not that he sacrifices a blemished animal, but that he eats it in the status of ma'aser, and it is forbidden to shear it or work it)]; nor shall he substitute (another animal) for it — and if he did substitute for it, then it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.


###### Leviticus 27:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Leviticus/r/27:34)


אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
These are the commandments which Adonoy commanded Moshe for Bnei Yisroel on Mount Sinai. **Chazak**


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
These are the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moshe for the children of Yisra᾽el in Mount Sinay.
			
			
				Vayyiqra


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
These are the mitzvoth which the L-rd charged Moses to (command to) the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
